title: Immigration Paralegal (Immigration Court)
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Immigration Paralegal (Immigration Court) em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Are you ready to build a meaningful career defending immigrants facing deportation? Do you thrive in fast‑paced environments, stay calm under pressure, and want to fight for people who need it most?


If so, Bueno Law wants to meet you.


About Bueno Law


Bueno Law is a Queer‑owned immigration law firm dedicated to protecting LGBTQ+ immigrants, survivors of domestic violence and human trafficking, and other marginalized communities.


We specialize in:


  • Removal Defense (EOIR) .
  • Asylum & Humanitarian Relief (U/T visas, VAWA, SIJS).
  • Family‑Based Immigration .


We’re expanding our Removal Defense Team and seeking passionate, detail‑driven Paralegals committed to making a real impact.


What You’ll Do (Removal Defense Focus)


  • Support EOIR litigation by preparing filings, motions, briefs, and applications for relief (asylum, cancellation, waivers, adjustment, etc.).
  • Draft client declarations and gather evidence for high‑stakes court submissions.
  • Manage a removal‑defense caseload , track deadlines, and maintain accurate case records.
  • Prepare hearing packets , organize exhibits, and assist attorneys with trial preparation.
  • Communicate with clients —often in emotionally sensitive situations—to collect facts and provide updates.
  • Coordinate with interpreters, experts, and agencies to support case strategy.
  • Prepare and file USCIS petitions for clients with mixed EOIR/USCIS matters.


What We’re Looking For

Hard Skills


  • Fluent in English + Spanish or Portuguese.
  • 3 years experience in with end to end removal defense (need experience with litigation).
  • Strong legal writing, research, and evidence‑gathering skills.
  • Highly organized and detail‑oriented with the ability to manage a heavy caseload.
  • Tech‑savvy and fully equipped for remote work (computer, internet, private workspace, noise‑canceling headphones).


Soft Skills


  • Emotionally intelligent communicator who can support clients during stressful moments.
  • Thrives in fast‑paced, mission‑driven environments.
  • Team‑oriented, proactive, adaptable, and solutions‑focused.
  • A sense of humor—because the work is intense, and we believe in supporting each other.


Preferred Qualifications


  • 3 + years of immigration paralegal experience .
  • Experience with both EOIR and USCIS filings.


What We Offer


  • Competitive pay above market rate .
  • Paid vacation + sick leave.
  • Your birthday off .
  • U.S. paid holidays.
  • Mon–Fri, 9 AM–6 PM PST .
  • A mission‑driven, inclusive, supportive team.


How to Apply


Send your resume to with the position in the subject line.

Applications submitted through LinkedIn will not be reviewed.

title: Data Science Specialist | Feature Store & ML Platform
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Data Science Specialist | Feature Store & ML Platform em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Data Science Specialist | Feature Store & ML Platform| (Remote)



Responsabilidades e atribuições


  • Liderar o desenvolvimento e evolução das capacidades da Feature Store: data lineage, feature views, feature recommendation e novos motores de consulta;
  • Projetar e implementar tabelas Apache Iceberg com foco em performance de leitura, versionamento e evolução de schema;
  • Arquitetar e otimizar a camada de serving com Redis para features em tempo real com SLOs rigorosos de latência;
  • Integrar e otimizar Amazon EMR como motor de consulta e processamento em escala;
  • Definir e implementar pipelines de feature selection e transformação com rastreabilidade end-to-end;
  • Estabelecer padrões de qualidade, versionamento e governança de features para toda a plataforma;
  • Atuar como referência técnica para times de dados e ciência que consomem a Feature Store.
  • Requisitos e qualificações
  • Expertise comprovada em engenharia de features em plataformas de ML corporativas (Feast, Tecton, Hopsworks ou equivalentes)
  • Domínio avançado de Apache Spark / PySpark para processamento distribuído em escala
  • Profundo conhecimento de Apache Iceberg e arquiteturas lakehouse (comparativo com Delta Lake e Hudi)
  • Expertise em Redis para feature serving em baixa latência, incluindo estratégias de cache invalidation e serialização eficiente
  • Experiência sólida com AWS e seus serviços de dados em produção (S3, Glue, EMR, Redshift, Athena)


Desejáveis:


  • Domínio de data lineage e catálogos de metadados (DataHub, OpenMetadata, Marquez) em produção;
  • Experiência com Amazon EMR: configuração, otimização de clusters e tuning de jobs Spark;
  • Expertise em práticas de MLOps com foco em versionamento e rastreabilidade de artefatos de dados;
  • Atuação anterior em contexto financeiro com dados de alta cardinalidade, alta frequência e requisitos regulatórios;
  • Conhecimento de ferramentas de qualidade de dados em escala (Great Expectations, Soda, dbt tests).






Become a Compasser, be part of AI/R.

Compass UOL is a global firm and part of the AI Revolution Company, together transforming organizations using Artificial Intelligence, Generative AI, and other of today’s most advanced technologies.


We equip our team with proprietary and external AI-driven tools to design and build digital-native platforms, integrating cutting-edge technologies and enabling companies to innovate, transform their businesses, and drive success in their markets.

To achieve this, we attract and develop the best talent, creating opportunities that enhance people’s lives and highlight the positive impact of disruptive technologies.

We empower borderless talent and promote knowledge and opportunities in the latest market trends, driving significant personal and professional growth.

  • Join us and be part of the AI-driven revolution.

title: Arquiteto Especialista IA
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Arquiteto Especialista IA em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Sobre a Empresa

Há mais de 20 anos mercado, somos uma consultoria estratégica de Inovação e Transformação Digital. Nossa especialidade é impulsionar as demandas de nossos clientes, integrando processos, pessoas e tecnologia de alta performance.


Sobre o Cargo: Arquiteto Especialista IA - REMOTA


• Experiência sólida em arquitetura de soluções de IA com LLMs, RAG avançado (multi-query, hybrid search, re-ranking e GraphRAG) e agentes especializados.

• Vivência prática na construção e operação de sistemas multiagentes, incluindo roteamento, planejamento, delegação e orquestração distribuída de agentes.

• Conhecimento em Model Context Protocol (MCP) e padrões Agent-to-Agent (A2A) para integração e comunicação entre agentes.

• Experiência com desenvolvimento assistido por IA utilizando ferramentas como Claude Code, Antigravity ou equivalentes.

• Domínio de Spec-Driven Development (SDD), transformando requisitos de negócio em especificações executáveis e arquiteturas escaláveis.

• Experiência prática com bancos vetoriais como Pinecone , ChromaDB, FAISS , Vertex AI Vector Search e estratégias de embeddings/chunking.

• Conhecimento sólido em sistemas distribuídos, mensageria, observabilidade, resiliência, idempotência e escalabilidade.

• Experiência com cloud computing, preferencialmente Google Cloud Platform (GCP), incluindo Vertex AI, BigQuery e Spanner.

• Forte conhecimento em Python e integração de APIs e ferramentas para workloads de IA.


Requisitos obrigatórios

• Experiência sólida com arquitetura de soluções de IA utilizando LLMs, RAG e sistemas multiagentes.

• Conhecimento avançado em padrões modernos de RAG, incluindo multi-query, hybrid search, re-ranking e GraphRAG.

• Experiência prática no desenvolvimento e orquestração de agentes especializados e arquiteturas Agent-to-Agent (A2A).

• Domínio de Model Context Protocol (MCP) para integração de ferramentas, fontes de dados e capacidades de agentes.

• Experiência com desenvolvimento assistido por IA (AI-Assisted Development), utilizando ferramentas como Claude Code , Antigravity ou equivalentes.

• Vivência com Spec-Driven Development (SDD) e transformação de requisitos de negócio em especificações técnicas executáveis.

• Experiência prática com bancos vetoriais como Pinecone, ChromaDB, FAISS, Vertex AI Vector Search ou equivalentes.

• Conhecimento sólido em embeddings, chunking, retrieval pipelines e busca semântica.

• Sólida experiência com sistemas distribuídos, mensageria, observabilidade, resiliência e escalabilidade.

• Experiência com desenvolvimento backend e integração de APIs para workloads de IA.

• Conhecimento avançado em Python aplicado a soluções de IA e automação.

• Experiência com ambientes cloud, preferencialmente Google Cloud Platform (GCP).

• Capacidade de atuar de forma estratégica e hands-on na definição de arquitetura e padrões de engenharia.


Requisitos desejáveis

  • Experiência em ambiente Google Cloud, especialmente Vertex AI, Gemini Enterprise , Agent Development Kit (ADK), Agent Builder, BigQuery e Spanner.
  • Vivência em ambientes regulados, como pagamentos, bancário ou setor público, com atenção a LGPD, segurança e auditabilidade de sistemas de IA.
  • Histórico de levar agentes para produção em larga escala, com métricas claras de qualidade, custo e latência.
  • Contribuições em comunidade, open source, publicações ou palestras na área de agentes e IA aplicada.


Todas as nossas oportunidades de trabalho estão abertas para pessoas com deficiência.

Apoiamos a diversidade!

#VemPraSIS #SomosSIS

title: Médico Nefrologista em Telemedicina (com RQE)
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Médico Nefrologista em Telemedicina (com RQE) em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

*OPORTUNIDADE PARA MÉDICO NEFROLOGISTA NA TELADOC HEALTH\"


Junte-se à Nossa Equipe de Saúde Digital!


A Teladoc Health, líder global em saúde digital e inovação em cuidados de saúde, está buscando Médicos e Médicas Especialistas em Nefrologia! Se você é um profissional comprometido com a excelência no atendimento ao paciente e deseja fazer parte de uma revolução na prestação de serviços de saúde, esta é a oportunidade que você estava esperando.


*SOBRE A TELADOC HEALTH: *

A Teladoc Health está na vanguarda da transformação da saúde, oferecendo acesso rápido, conveniente e confiável a serviços de saúde através de nossa plataforma digital. Nossa missão é tornar o cuidado de saúde acessível a todos, em qualquer lugar e a qualquer momento. Combinando tecnologia de ponta e conhecimento médico, estamos moldando o futuro da saúde e proporcionando impacto positivo na vida de milhões de pessoas.


*O QUE PROCURAMOS: *


Você será responsável por realizar consultas por vídeo e telefone, por intermédio de plataforma do empregador, atendendo na especialidade de Nefrologia , de forma ética, com abordagem biopsicossocial do processo saúde-adoecimento, integrando ações de prevenção, promoção, proteção, recuperação e educação em saúde buscando alcançar os melhores resultados clínicos.


*PAPEIS E RESPONSABILIDADES*


  • Fornecer atendimento médico especializado em Nefrologia de forma remota, através de consultas e avaliações realizadas por meio de plataformas digitais de comunicação.


  • Experiência e conhecimento para o diagnóstico, tratamento e acompanhamento de pacientes com doenças e distúrbios nefrológicos.


  • Realizar consultas em Telemedicina sendo capaz de: conduzir anmneses virtuais para coletar queixas e histórico médico, realizar exame clínico e avaliações à distância, interpretar resultados de exames laboratoriais e de imagem, elaborar diagnósticos precisos, propor medidas terapêuticas e orientações de cuidado, reconhecer sinais de gravidade em Nefrologia e critérios para encaminhar ao atendimento presencial.


  • Habilidade em conduzir entrevistas detalhadas e observar sintomas e sinais da especialidade Nefrologia através de videochamadas.


  • Atuar de forma a priorizar a prática médica centrada na pessoa.


  • Elaborar planos de tratamento individualizados, levando em consideração as necessidades específicas de cada paciente.


  • Ser hábil na prescrição de medicamentos adequados para tratar doenças nefrológicas.


  • Monitorar o progresso dos pacientes ao longo do tratamento em telemedicina.


  • Realizar ajustes no plano de tratamento, conforme necessário, com base na resposta do paciente ao tratamento.


  • Desenvolver atividades integrais de saúde, incorporando prevenção e promoção de saúde para dar as respostas mais adequadas às necessidades de saúde apresentadas.


  • Atender com elevado grau de qualidade, sendo resolutivo na grande maioria das orientações acerca de problemas de saúde em Nefrologia.


  • Considerar os valores e preferências pessoais do paciente conjuntamente às melhores evidências científicas e à experiência de manejo clínico para efetivamente promover a melhor prática clínica e os melhores desfechos em saúde para cada indivíduo.


  • Exercer uso racional de recursos em saúde visando a segurança do paciente e a prevenção quaternária, evitando sobrediagnóstico e sobretratamento, que expõe os indivíduos a maiores riscos do que benefícios em saúde.


  • Estimular a participação e a autonomia dos indivíduos e familiares, fortalecendo a aderência a tratamentos e medidas de autocuidado.


  • Documentar todas as interações e informações relevantes dos pacientes em prontuários eletrônicos seguros e confidenciais.


  • Ter capacidade de crítica de sua própria atividade médica, considerando-a em seus aspectos científicos, éticos e sociais para aprimoramento contínuo.


  • Manter-se bem informado e atualizado, ampliando sua própria competência em relação a conhecimentos sobre riscos em saúde e sobre as medidas mais eficientes para eliminar ou reduzir os riscos relevantes.


  • Respeitar, cumprir e fazer cumprir os ditames do Código de Ética Médica, bem como a Legislação vigente e os regulamentos internos formais da Instituição.



REQUISITOS


Formação Acadêmica:

  • Obrigatório: GRADUAÇÃO EM MEDICINA
  • RESIDÊNCIA MÉDICA CONCLUÍDA OU ESPECIALIZAÇÃO/PÓS EM NEFROLOGIA.


Certificações:

  • Registro ativo no Conselho Regional de Medicina (CRM);
  • Certificado de Título de Especialista em Nefrologia - RQE (Emitido pelo Conselho do respectivo Estado);
  • Certificado Digital Ativo reconhecido pela Infraestrutura de Chaves Públicas Brasileira (ICP-Brasil);



Experiência:

Experiência em atividades relacionadas à atuação em atendimento médico em Nefrologia, sendo desejável experiência prévia em Telemedicina.



Conhecimentos Específicos para a função:

Competência em prestar orientações personalizadas a indivíduos e suas famílias com conhecimentos para o diagnóstico, tratamento e acompanhamento de pacientes com doenças e distúrbios nefrológicos.



Competências Comportamentais:

Comprometimento com os pacientes, com ideais e valores da empresa, apresentando postura ética, pontualidade, capacidade de integração com equipe multiprofissional.



Outros Requisitos Importantes:

Conhecimentos e Habilidades em computação: uso do Pacote Office (Excel, Word, Power Point, Gráficos) e Internet. Familiaridade com tecnologias de telemedicina e uso de plataformas de comunicação virtual é um diferencial desejável.


Local de Trabalho:

REMOTO


Remuneração e Agendamentos: a combinar durante processo seletivo.



IMPORTANTE:


MODELO DE CONTRATAÇÃO: Contratação em regime de Prestador de Serviços por contrato Pessoa Jurídica, necessário fazer parte como representante legal ou sócio de um CNPJ ativo, bem como possuir CRM do respectivo CNPJ ativo.


Esta descrição de cargo/atuação tem caráter informativo e pode ser ajustada conforme a necessidade da empresa ou instituição que oferece a oportunidade de trabalho em telemedicina para Médico Clínico/Generalista Residente em Gastroenterologista.

title: Back End Developer
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Back End Developer em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Senior Software Engineer (Backend-Focused – Ruby/Elixir Platform Transformation)


Position Overview

We are seeking a Senior Software Engineer to join a backend-focused engineering team responsible for modernizing and transforming core vendor platform systems. This role will primarily focus on building scalable backend services, improving vendor onboarding and intake workflows, and contributing to a large multi-year platform transformation initiative.

The ideal candidate is a strong backend engineer with experience building distributed systems, scalable APIs, and cloud-native applications using Ruby, Elixir, or other strongly typed object-oriented backend languages such as Java, Kotlin, or C#.

This is a hands-on engineering role focused on execution, reliability, and delivery within a collaborative Agile environment.


Key Responsibilities

  • Design, develop, and maintain scalable backend services and APIs
  • Contribute to the Vendor Platform Transformation initiative and modernization efforts
  • Build clean, performant, testable, and maintainable code
  • Work on distributed systems, event-driven workflows, and backend integrations
  • Participate in system design discussions and architectural decision-making
  • Collaborate closely with engineering, product, and cross-functional teams
  • Support migration and modernization of legacy systems into scalable cloud-native services
  • Review pull requests and contribute to engineering best practices
  • Troubleshoot production issues and improve system reliability and observability
  • Contribute to backend workflows involving vendor onboarding, intake processing, and operational systems


Required Qualifications

  • 5-7+ years of software engineering experience
  • Strong backend engineering experience with Ruby and/or Elixir
  • Experience with Java, Kotlin, C#, Go, or other strongly typed backend languages is highly valued
  • Strong understanding of scalable backend systems and distributed architectures
  • Experience building REST APIs and microservices
  • Familiarity with event-driven systems and messaging platforms such as Kafka or RabbitMQ
  • Experience with cloud infrastructure such as AWS or GCP
  • Strong understanding of databases such as PostgreSQL, Redis, or NoSQL systems
  • Experience working in Agile/Scrum development environments
  • Ability to write clean, maintainable, and testable code
  • Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines, Docker, and containerized deployments
  • Strong problem-solving and debugging skills


Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with Elixir/Phoenix ecosystems
  • Experience working on platform transformation or migration initiatives
  • Familiarity with domain-driven design (DDD) and scalable service design
  • Exposure to observability, logging, and monitoring tools
  • Experience with GraphQL
  • Experience with distributed data processing or ingestion pipelines
  • Familiarity with eCommerce, marketplace, logistics, or vendor onboarding systems

▪ Institucional:

▪ Instagram:

▪ Facebook:

Na ION Sistemas, somos IONizadores, parceiros em uma jornada de transformação digital e sucesso. Nosso compromisso vai além de oferecer soluções; buscamos impactar resultados e processos com inovação e eficiência. São diferenciais:

description:

Desenvolvedor(a) Flutter - Sênior

A jornada de quem ama repensar o futuro está aqui.


Sobre a Rethink

Somos uma consultoria que une tecnologia, design e estratégia de produtos digitais para solucionar os desafios de grandes empresas brasileiras. Agora como parte da Framework Digital , ampliamos nosso impacto atuando de ponta a ponta na jornada digital, da concepção à escala.


Nossa missão é gerar valor real por meio de soluções que conectam times, sistemas e pessoas. Acreditamos que a transformação digital acontece quando estratégia, tecnologia e experiência andam juntas e é isso que entregamos.


Empresas como Smiles, Gol, Santander Esfera, Swift e Comgás confiam em nossa parceria para acelerar sua evolução digital com consistência e resultado.

Diversidade e Inclusão

Para repensar o futuro, é essencial garantir ambientes mais diversos e inclusivos . Por isso, incentivamos fortemente a candidatura de mulheres, pessoas pretas, pardas, indígenas, LGBTQIAPN+ e pessoas com deficiência .

Que tal repensar um futuro mais diverso com a gente?

Qual será o seu papel?

Você vai atuar como desenvolvedor(a) Flutter em um app com alto volume de usuários e impacto direto em vendas, trabalhando em uma arquitetura madura e bem estruturada. Seu foco será evoluir fluxos críticos junto a um time multidisciplinar, garantindo qualidade, performance e aderência ao Design System, com liberdade real para propor melhorias estruturais no produto.


Como será seu dia a dia?

Você vai colaborar de perto com Produto, Design, Backend e QA na construção e evolução de funcionalidades, participar de code reviews, contribuir com a documentação interna e garantir que o app funcione bem nos dois mercados que atendemos: Brasil e EUA, em iOS e Android. O uso de IA (Claude Code, Copilot e similares) faz parte da rotina do time; esperamos que você use essas ferramentas com fluência e senso crítico, revisando o que é gerado e respondendo pela qualidade das entregas.


Para esta vaga, é essencial:

  • Experiência sólida em Flutter / Dart com apps publicados em loja (iOS e Android);
  • Domínio de Clean Architecture ou arquiteturas por camadas (domain / data / presentation);
  • Experiência com gerenciamento de estado (GetX, Bloc, Riverpod ou similar);
  • Consumo de APIs REST, tratamento de erros e autenticação via JWT;
  • Conhecimento de testes em Flutter (unitários e de widget);
  • Git com fluxo de pull requests, code review e branches por feature/bugfix;
  • Integrações nativas básicas em Android (Gradle, flavors) e iOS (Xcode, CocoaPods);
  • Inglês avançado ou fluente.


Você pode se destacar se:

  • Tiver experiência com ferramentas de CRM e mensageria como Emarsys, OneSignal ou Braze (push + in-app);
  • Conhecer plataformas de atribuição mobile como AppsFlyer ou Adjust;
  • Já tiver trabalhado com CI/CD mobile usando Fastlane, Codemagic, Bitrise ou GitHub Actions;
  • Souber propor melhorias em prompts, automações e fluxos com IA que aumentem a produtividade do time;


Curtiu a oportunidade?

Então, vem repensar o futuro com a gente! ✨

  • Interesse em aprender e atuar com outras tecnologias quando necessário;
  • Bons conhecimentos em lógica de programação;
  • Conhecimento em integração de sistemas e APIs;
  • Perfil autogerenciável, colaborativo e com facilidade para trabalhar em equipe.


São diferenciais:

  • Experiência em projetos de integração.


E o que nós oferecemos para que você faça bem o seu trabalho:

  • Vale refeição ou alimentação (mesmo durante férias);
  • Plano de saúde e odontológico 100% coberto pela empresa;
  • Auxílio home-office R$100,00/mensais;
  • Auxílio setup home-office (para caprichar no seu espaço de trabalho em casa);
  • Reembolso em cursos de inglês, tecnologia e afins;
  • Convênio Araújo;

  • Suporte psicológico;

title: Back End Developer
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Back End Developer em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Senior Software Engineer (Backend-Focused – Ruby/Elixir Platform Transformation)


Position Overview

We are seeking a Senior Software Engineer to join a backend-focused engineering team responsible for modernizing and transforming core vendor platform systems. This role will primarily focus on building scalable backend services, improving vendor onboarding and intake workflows, and contributing to a large multi-year platform transformation initiative.

The ideal candidate is a strong backend engineer with experience building distributed systems, scalable APIs, and cloud-native applications using Ruby, Elixir, or other strongly typed object-oriented backend languages such as Java, Kotlin, or C#.

This is a hands-on engineering role focused on execution, reliability, and delivery within a collaborative Agile environment.


Key Responsibilities

  • Design, develop, and maintain scalable backend services and APIs
  • Contribute to the Vendor Platform Transformation initiative and modernization efforts
  • Build clean, performant, testable, and maintainable code
  • Work on distributed systems, event-driven workflows, and backend integrations
  • Participate in system design discussions and architectural decision-making
  • Collaborate closely with engineering, product, and cross-functional teams
  • Support migration and modernization of legacy systems into scalable cloud-native services
  • Review pull requests and contribute to engineering best practices
  • Troubleshoot production issues and improve system reliability and observability
  • Contribute to backend workflows involving vendor onboarding, intake processing, and operational systems


Required Qualifications

  • 5-7+ years of software engineering experience
  • Strong backend engineering experience with Ruby and/or Elixir
  • Experience with Java, Kotlin, C#, Go, or other strongly typed backend languages is highly valued
  • Strong understanding of scalable backend systems and distributed architectures
  • Experience building REST APIs and microservices
  • Familiarity with event-driven systems and messaging platforms such as Kafka or RabbitMQ
  • Experience with cloud infrastructure such as AWS or GCP
  • Strong understanding of databases such as PostgreSQL, Redis, or NoSQL systems
  • Experience working in Agile/Scrum development environments
  • Ability to write clean, maintainable, and testable code
  • Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines, Docker, and containerized deployments
  • Strong problem-solving and debugging skills


Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with Elixir/Phoenix ecosystems
  • Experience working on platform transformation or migration initiatives
  • Familiarity with domain-driven design (DDD) and scalable service design
  • Exposure to observability, logging, and monitoring tools
  • Experience with GraphQL
  • Experience with distributed data processing or ingestion pipelines
  • Familiarity with eCommerce, marketplace, logistics, or vendor onboarding systems

Sobre a Rethink

Somos uma consultoria que une tecnologia, design e estratégia de produtos digitais para solucionar os desafios de grandes empresas brasileiras. Agora como parte da Framework Digital , ampliamos nosso impacto atuando de ponta a ponta na jornada digital, da concepção à escala.


Nossa missão é gerar valor real por meio de soluções que conectam times, sistemas e pessoas. Acreditamos que a transformação digital acontece quando estratégia, tecnologia e experiência andam juntas e é isso que entregamos.


Empresas como Smiles, Gol, Santander Esfera, Swift e Comgás confiam em nossa parceria para acelerar sua evolução digital com consistência e resultado.

Diversidade e Inclusão

Para repensar o futuro, é essencial garantir ambientes mais diversos e inclusivos . Por isso, incentivamos fortemente a candidatura de mulheres, pessoas pretas, pardas, indígenas, LGBTQIAPN+ e pessoas com deficiência .

Que tal repensar um futuro mais diverso com a gente?

Qual será o seu papel?

Você vai atuar como desenvolvedor(a) Flutter em um app com alto volume de usuários e impacto direto em vendas, trabalhando em uma arquitetura madura e bem estruturada. Seu foco será evoluir fluxos críticos junto a um time multidisciplinar, garantindo qualidade, performance e aderência ao Design System, com liberdade real para propor melhorias estruturais no produto.


Como será seu dia a dia?

Você vai colaborar de perto com Produto, Design, Backend e QA na construção e evolução de funcionalidades, participar de code reviews, contribuir com a documentação interna e garantir que o app funcione bem nos dois mercados que atendemos: Brasil e EUA, em iOS e Android. O uso de IA (Claude Code, Copilot e similares) faz parte da rotina do time; esperamos que você use essas ferramentas com fluência e senso crítico, revisando o que é gerado e respondendo pela qualidade das entregas.


Para esta vaga, é essencial:

  • Experiência sólida em Flutter / Dart com apps publicados em loja (iOS e Android);
  • Domínio de Clean Architecture ou arquiteturas por camadas (domain / data / presentation);
  • Experiência com gerenciamento de estado (GetX, Bloc, Riverpod ou similar);

Informações adicionais

title: Project Manager
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Project Manager em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

About Lilo Social

Lilo Social is a full-funnel eCommerce growth agency specializing in acquisition and retention for direct-to-consumer brands. With a team of over 75 professionals, we deliver best-in-class paid media, email marketing, and creative services to help brands scale profitably. We work across the entire customer lifecycle: from content creation and paid advertising to conversion rate optimization and retention marketing.


Our partnership-first approach has earned us a 90% client retention rate and recognition as an Inc. 5000 honoree for three consecutive years (2023, 2024, 2025). We are proud to be a Klaviyo Master Elite Agency, a distinction held by only 0.2% of Klaviyo's 6,500+ partners. To date, we have driven billions of dollars in attributed revenue for our partners.


The Role

We are seeking a Project Manager to serve as the operational backbone of client delivery, coordinating workflows across creative, media, and retention teams. You will be responsible for managing project timelines, organizing resources, and ensuring seamless communication between internal teams and clients to maintain the high standard of service our partners expect.


What Success Looks Like

  • Consistent on-time delivery of client deliverables and campaign launches
  • Streamlined workflows that eliminate bottlenecks and improve team velocity
  • High client satisfaction scores through proactive communication and organized project management
  • Well-documented processes that scale efficiently as the team and client base grow


Responsibilities

  • Manage project timelines and deliverables across multiple client accounts simultaneously
  • Coordinate between creative, media buying, retention, and account teams to allocate resources effectively
  • Organize weekly client meeting agendas, take detailed notes, and create actionable task lists from meeting outcomes
  • Create and assign Asana tasks for internal teams based on client requests and monthly retainer deliverables
  • Track creative production pipelines and monitor asset status from brief through completion
  • Build and maintain SOPs for internal processes, organized in Notion
  • Set up and manage client project management tools including Google Drive, Asana, Slack, and creative proofing platforms
  • Lead internal team standups and coordinate cross-functional project kickoffs
  • Handle client onboarding processes and schedule kick-off calls with appropriate stakeholders
  • Identify workflow bottlenecks and proactively implement process improvements
  • Maintain comprehensive documentation of scope of work for each client account
  • Keep all project stakeholders aligned and informed to ensure client retention and satisfaction


Requirements

  • 4+ years of project management experience in a digital marketing or agency environment
  • Highly organized with exceptional attention to detail and follow-through
  • Familiarity with eCommerce platforms and digital advertising (Facebook Ads, Google Ads, email marketing)
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills with clients and internal teams
  • Proven ability to manage multiple projects and competing priorities in a fast-paced environment
  • Expert proficiency with Google Drive (Docs, Sheets, Slides)
  • Experience with project management and collaboration tools (Asana, Notion, Slack)
  • Ability to work independently while fostering collaborative team relationships


Nice to Have

  • Experience working in a digital advertising or eCommerce agency
  • Familiarity with creative production workflows and asset management
  • Experience with Figma, Frame.io, or other creative collaboration tools
  • Background in managing subscription-based or retainer client relationships
  • Process documentation and SOP development experience


Compensation and Benefits

  • 401(k) Retirement Plan : Fully customizable 401(k) with up to 4% company match
  • Comprehensive Health Coverage : Fully-covered medical, dental, and vision insurance
  • Generous Time Off : Competitive PTO policy and paid holidays to maintain work-life balance
  • Wellness Benefits : Complimentary Headspace subscription and fitness stipend
  • Fully Remote : Work from anywhere with flexible hours and a distributed team culture
  • Technology Supplied : Equipped with the latest laptop and necessary tools for success
  • Professional Development : Opportunities for growth, training, and expanded responsibilities
  • Compensation: Competitive salary commensurate with experience

title: Software Engineer - UI
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Software Engineer - UI em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Most frontend roles are just building screens.


This isn’t one of them.


This is a chance to own a real-time, collaborative, AI-native product surface - the part of the system where users actually work, make decisions, and rely on the output.


Think Notion or Google Docs-style interaction design, applied to a high-stakes domain where correctness and usability matter.


Why this role is interesting:


  • You’ll own state-heavy, collaborative UI systems , not just components
  • You’ll work on real-time multi-user editing and syncing problems
  • You’ll integrate AI directly into the product experience , not as a bolt-on
  • You’ll join a small, high-performing team with real product traction
  • You’ll have direct influence over product direction and UX standards


This is one of the highest-priority engineering hires on the team right now.


What you’ll be doing:


  • Building rich editing and collaboration experiences (shared editing, commenting, annotation)
  • Designing UI systems where multiple users interact in real time
  • Solving state, sync, and performance challenges across frontend and backend
  • Working closely with product and design to ship fast and iterate
  • Integrating AI workflows into user-facing interfaces


What they’re looking for:


  • 3+ years building complex web applications
  • Strong frontend foundation (React, TypeScript, Next.js)
  • Experience with rich UI, editing flows, or collaborative systems
  • Comfortable owning features end-to-end
  • High bar for product quality and interaction design


Strong signals:


  • ProseMirror, Tiptap, or Yjs
  • Real-time collaboration / multi-user systems
  • Editor or document-based product experience
  • AI or LLM workflows in product interfaces


Comp & setup:


  • Remote (US)
  • Small team, high ownership, fast-moving environment


Why it’s a good move:


If you’ve worked on editor-like or collaboration-heavy products before, this is a rare opportunity to go deeper on:


  • real-time systems
  • complex UI architecture
  • AI-native product design


…and do it in a setting where your work actually defines the product.

title: Strategy & Operations Manager (Revenue)
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Strategy & Operations Manager (Revenue) em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

About Revolut

People deserve more from their money. More visibility, more control, and more freedom. Since 2015, Revolut has been on a mission to deliver just that. Our powerhouse of products — including spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more — help our 75+ million customers get more from their money every day.

As we continue our lightning-fast growth, 2 things are essential to our success: our people and our culture. In recognition of our outstanding employee experience, we've been certified as a Great Place to Work™. So far, we have 13,000+ people working around the world, from our offices and remotely, to help us achieve our mission. And we're looking for more brilliant people. People who love building great products, redefining success, and turning the complexity of a chaotic world into the simplicity of a beautiful solution.

About the role

At Revolut, Operations means problem-solving at scale. Our team tackles the company’s toughest challenges with speed, precision, and creativity. They design systems that unlock efficiency and power global growth.

We're looking for a Revenue Operations Manager to work on high-impact initiatives throughout the business, using insight to solve challenges, scale processes, and deliver better outcomes for our customers.

Watch this video from our team members about what goes into being a Strategy & Operations Manager at Revolut.

Up to shape what's next in finance? Let’s get in touch.

What you’ll be doing

  • Building and optimising scalable processes to continue Revolut's hyper-growth
  • Leading and executing core infrastructure projects end to end
  • Exploring and defining which projects the team should prioritise, and setting a timeline to reach goals quickly
  • Searching for new features to provide a seamless customer experience
  • Managing critical vendor relationships and building performance tracking systems
  • Developing strategic supply chain partnerships and negotiating commercial terms

What you'll need

  • At least a 2:1 degree from a top university
  • 2+ years of work experience in a fast-paced environment
  • A solid track record of taking ownership and leading complex projects
  • The ability to break complex problems into smaller ones
  • To enjoy working with data
  • Natural curiosity and a will to make an impact
  • An interest in the financial industry

Nice to have

  • Experience coding with SQL, Python, and/or R

Compensation range

  • Krakow: PLN15,700 - PLN35,800 gross monthly*
  • Poland: PLN15,700 - PLN35,800 gross monthly*
  • Other locations: Compensation will be discussed during the interview process

*Final compensation will be determined based on the candidate's qualifications, skills, and previous experience

title: Senior Front End Engineer
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Senior Front End Engineer em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Senior Front End Engineer



About Sphise Technologies


Sphise Technologies is a global outsourcing and talent solutions company, partnering with high-growth businesses to build strong, high-impact teams across finance, technology, and operations.

For one of our clients, a mid-sized company operating at scale, we are currently looking to hire a Senior Front End Engineer.


Role Overview

We are seeking a Senior Front End Engineer to lead custom front-end development for a

Sitecore DXP / OrderCloud implementation. This role will be the first dedicated front-end

engineer on the project and is expected to operate with a high degree of autonomy,

technical ownership, and architectural judgment.

This is not a theme-tweaking role. You will design, build, and evolve a modern headless

front end integrated with Sitecore DXP and OrderCloud APIs.


Key Responsibilities


• Design and implement a custom headless front end for Sitecore DXP / OrderCloud

using modern JavaScript frameworks.

• Build production-grade applications using Next.js, with deployment targets such as

Vercel or Netlify.

• Integrate front-end applications with:

-OrderCloud APIs

-Sitecore DXP APIs

-Authentication, catalog, search, pricing, and checkout services

• Translate UX/UI designs into scalable, accessible, and performant front-end

implementations.

• Establish front-end architecture patterns, conventions, and best practices suitable

for a growing team.

• Collaborate closely with UX, product, and backend teams to ensure clean API

contracts and realistic implementation.

• Optimize performance, SEO, and Core Web Vitals for commerce use cases.

• Participate in technical decision-making around tooling, frameworks, and

deployment strategy.

• Own front-end code quality, testing approach, and release readiness.

Required Qualifications

• 5+ years of professional front-end development experience.

• Strong hands-on experience with Next.js and React in production environments.

• Experience building headless or composable front ends for CMS or commerce

platforms.

• Solid understanding of modern front-end architecture:

-SSR, SSG, ISR

-Client vs server components

-State management patterns

• Strong proficiency in JavaScript/TypeScript, HTML, and CSS.

• Experience integrating REST and/or GraphQL APIs.

• Familiarity with modern deployment platforms such as Vercel or Netlify.

• Familiarity with design systems and component-driven development.

• Comfortable working as an initial solo contributor while setting foundations for

future scale.


Preferred Experience

• Proactive use of AI-assisted code generation tools (e.g., Cursor + Claude) to:

-Accelerate development, refactoring, and prototyping.

-Design and implement automated tests (unit, integration, and E2E) for

modern front-end applications.

-Leverage Figma MCP to translate Figma designs directly into production-

ready component code, reducing design-to-implementation cycle time.

• Hands-on experience with headless CMS/commerce platforms.

• Experience working on B2B or complex eCommerce applications.

• Ability to read, understand, and modify code in adjacent front‑end frameworks such

as AngularJS or similar React‑like ecosystems.


Benefits

  • Competitive salary to recognize and reward your achievements.
  • Flexible work environment.
  • Opportunities for professional and personal growth.

title: Senior Front End Engineer
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Senior Front End Engineer em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Senior Front End Engineer



About Sphise Technologies


Sphise Technologies is a global outsourcing and talent solutions company, partnering with high-growth businesses to build strong, high-impact teams across finance, technology, and operations.

For one of our clients, a mid-sized company operating at scale, we are currently looking to hire a Senior Front End Engineer.


Role Overview

We are seeking a Senior Front End Engineer to lead custom front-end development for a

Sitecore DXP / OrderCloud implementation. This role will be the first dedicated front-end

engineer on the project and is expected to operate with a high degree of autonomy,

technical ownership, and architectural judgment.

This is not a theme-tweaking role. You will design, build, and evolve a modern headless

front end integrated with Sitecore DXP and OrderCloud APIs.


Key Responsibilities


• Design and implement a custom headless front end for Sitecore DXP / OrderCloud

using modern JavaScript frameworks.

• Build production-grade applications using Next.js, with deployment targets such as

Vercel or Netlify.

• Integrate front-end applications with:

-OrderCloud APIs

-Sitecore DXP APIs

-Authentication, catalog, search, pricing, and checkout services

• Translate UX/UI designs into scalable, accessible, and performant front-end

implementations.

• Establish front-end architecture patterns, conventions, and best practices suitable

for a growing team.

• Collaborate closely with UX, product, and backend teams to ensure clean API

contracts and realistic implementation.

• Optimize performance, SEO, and Core Web Vitals for commerce use cases.

• Participate in technical decision-making around tooling, frameworks, and

deployment strategy.

• Own front-end code quality, testing approach, and release readiness.

Required Qualifications

• 5+ years of professional front-end development experience.

• Strong hands-on experience with Next.js and React in production environments.

• Experience building headless or composable front ends for CMS or commerce

platforms.

• Solid understanding of modern front-end architecture:

-SSR, SSG, ISR

-Client vs server components

-State management patterns

• Strong proficiency in JavaScript/TypeScript, HTML, and CSS.

• Experience integrating REST and/or GraphQL APIs.

• Familiarity with modern deployment platforms such as Vercel or Netlify.

• Familiarity with design systems and component-driven development.

• Comfortable working as an initial solo contributor while setting foundations for

future scale.


Preferred Experience

• Proactive use of AI-assisted code generation tools (e.g., Cursor + Claude) to:

-Accelerate development, refactoring, and prototyping.

-Design and implement automated tests (unit, integration, and E2E) for

modern front-end applications.

-Leverage Figma MCP to translate Figma designs directly into production-

ready component code, reducing design-to-implementation cycle time.

• Hands-on experience with headless CMS/commerce platforms.

• Experience working on B2B or complex eCommerce applications.

• Ability to read, understand, and modify code in adjacent front‑end frameworks such

as AngularJS or similar React‑like ecosystems.


Benefits

  • Competitive salary to recognize and reward your achievements.
  • Flexible work environment.
  • Opportunities for professional and personal growth.

title: Project Manager
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Project Manager em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

About Lilo Social

Lilo Social is a full-funnel eCommerce growth agency specializing in acquisition and retention for direct-to-consumer brands. With a team of over 75 professionals, we deliver best-in-class paid media, email marketing, and creative services to help brands scale profitably. We work across the entire customer lifecycle: from content creation and paid advertising to conversion rate optimization and retention marketing.


Our partnership-first approach has earned us a 90% client retention rate and recognition as an Inc. 5000 honoree for three consecutive years (2023, 2024, 2025). We are proud to be a Klaviyo Master Elite Agency, a distinction held by only 0.2% of Klaviyo's 6,500+ partners. To date, we have driven billions of dollars in attributed revenue for our partners.


The Role

We are seeking a Project Manager to serve as the operational backbone of client delivery, coordinating workflows across creative, media, and retention teams. You will be responsible for managing project timelines, organizing resources, and ensuring seamless communication between internal teams and clients to maintain the high standard of service our partners expect.


What Success Looks Like

  • Consistent on-time delivery of client deliverables and campaign launches
  • Streamlined workflows that eliminate bottlenecks and improve team velocity
  • High client satisfaction scores through proactive communication and organized project management
  • Well-documented processes that scale efficiently as the team and client base grow


Responsibilities

  • Manage project timelines and deliverables across multiple client accounts simultaneously
  • Coordinate between creative, media buying, retention, and account teams to allocate resources effectively
  • Organize weekly client meeting agendas, take detailed notes, and create actionable task lists from meeting outcomes
  • Create and assign Asana tasks for internal teams based on client requests and monthly retainer deliverables
  • Track creative production pipelines and monitor asset status from brief through completion
  • Build and maintain SOPs for internal processes, organized in Notion
  • Set up and manage client project management tools including Google Drive, Asana, Slack, and creative proofing platforms
  • Lead internal team standups and coordinate cross-functional project kickoffs
  • Handle client onboarding processes and schedule kick-off calls with appropriate stakeholders
  • Identify workflow bottlenecks and proactively implement process improvements
  • Maintain comprehensive documentation of scope of work for each client account
  • Keep all project stakeholders aligned and informed to ensure client retention and satisfaction


Requirements

  • 4+ years of project management experience in a digital marketing or agency environment
  • Highly organized with exceptional attention to detail and follow-through
  • Familiarity with eCommerce platforms and digital advertising (Facebook Ads, Google Ads, email marketing)
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills with clients and internal teams
  • Proven ability to manage multiple projects and competing priorities in a fast-paced environment
  • Expert proficiency with Google Drive (Docs, Sheets, Slides)
  • Experience with project management and collaboration tools (Asana, Notion, Slack)
  • Ability to work independently while fostering collaborative team relationships


Nice to Have

  • Experience working in a digital advertising or eCommerce agency
  • Familiarity with creative production workflows and asset management
  • Experience with Figma, Frame.io, or other creative collaboration tools
  • Background in managing subscription-based or retainer client relationships
  • Process documentation and SOP development experience


Compensation and Benefits

  • 401(k) Retirement Plan : Fully customizable 401(k) with up to 4% company match
  • Comprehensive Health Coverage : Fully-covered medical, dental, and vision insurance
  • Generous Time Off : Competitive PTO policy and paid holidays to maintain work-life balance
  • Wellness Benefits : Complimentary Headspace subscription and fitness stipend
  • Fully Remote : Work from anywhere with flexible hours and a distributed team culture
  • Technology Supplied : Equipped with the latest laptop and necessary tools for success
  • Professional Development : Opportunities for growth, training, and expanded responsibilities
  • Compensation: Competitive salary commensurate with experience

title: Promo Team Lead - Brazil
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Promo Team Lead - Brazil em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

About Pocket FM


Pocket FM is the world’s largest audio-series platform, where powerful stories travel effortlessly across languages, cultures, and continents. From India and the US to Europe and beyond, we are redefining how stories are created, discovered, and experienced across the globe, without screens.


At our core, we are an AI-powered entertainment company with a deeply human-first philosophy. We believe technology should amplify creativity. Our proprietary AI systems work alongside writers, voice artists, and creative teams to help stories scale globally, faster, smarter, and with cultural depth and emotional integrity intact.


Today, Pocket FM is home to a vibrant community of 250+ million listeners, 300,000+ creators, and 100,000+ audio series. With over 140 billion minutes streamed annually, we have emerged as one of the fastest-growing media-tech companies in the world, and we are just getting started. We operate at a massive global scale, but with a startup mindset: curious, fast-moving, and deeply owner-driven. At Pocket FM, teams are encouraged to think boldly, move with intent, and build for long-term impact as we shape the future of audio-first storytelling worldwide.


Role Overview


We are looking for a creative and execution-focused Promo Team Lead to lead the end-to-end creation of promotional ads, trailers, and performance creatives for Pocket FM audio series in the Brazilian market.


As a Promo Team Lead, you will manage a team of promo writers, sound engineers, video editors, and dubbing partners to create high-quality promotional ads for Pocket FM audio series.


The role requires strong understanding of promo creation, ad storytelling, localization, dubbing workflows, quality control, team management, and creative optimization. You will oversee fresh promo creation, adaptation of ads from other geographies into Brazilian Portuguese, production quality, timely delivery, and reworks for ads that are not meeting performance benchmarks.


Key Responsibilities


1. Team Leadership & Creative Direction

  • Lead and guide promo writers, sound engineers, video editors, and external dubbing partners.
  • Provide creative direction across writing, dubbing, audio mixing, video editing, and final delivery.
  • Ensure the team is well-utilized, motivated, and aligned with business and creative goals.
  • Build a high-ownership culture focused on quality, speed, and performance.

2. Promo Creation & Localization

  • Oversee the creation of fresh promo ads, trailers, and long-form promotional scripts for audio series.
  • Adapt successful ads from other geographies into Brazilian Portuguese.
  • Ensure all promos are culturally relevant, emotionally engaging, and suitable for Brazilian audiences.
  • Guide the team on hooks, story setup, emotional beats, cliffhangers, and audience entry points.

3. Production & Quality Control

  • Own the end-to-end promo production process from brief to final asset delivery.
  • Quality check every stage, including writing, dubbing, audio mixing, video creation, and final output.
  • Review scripts, VO/dubbing output, audio edits, video cuts, captions, and final creatives.
  • Ensure every asset meets Pocket FM’s creative, language, production, and performance standards.

4. Dubbing Agency Management

  • Identify, evaluate, and onboard dubbing agencies for Brazilian Portuguese production.
  • Coordinate with agencies for script handover, voice casting, recording, revisions, and delivery.
  • Review dubbing output for pronunciation, emotion, pacing, tone, and character fit.
  • Track agency timelines, pending deliverables, feedback loops, and final submissions.

5. Performance Reworks & Optimization

  • Review ads that are not meeting benchmark metrics and identify key creative issues.
  • Create detailed and actionable rework hypotheses to improve ad performance.
  • Suggest improvements such as stronger hooks, sharper conflicts, better pacing, improved localization, or revised visuals.
  • Guide the team in creating alternate openings, new versions, and stronger creative angles.
  • Apply campaign learnings to improve future promo concepts and execution.

6. Process, Tracking & Reporting

  • Maintain show-level trackers for all ads being written, adapted, dubbed, edited, reviewed, and delivered.
  • Track ownership, status, timelines, delays, feedback, and final delivery for each asset.
  • Share weekly progress reports with the India team and relevant stakeholders.
  • Create SOPs, checklists, and workflows to avoid leakages across the production process.

7. AI Tool Adoption

  • Use GenAI tools for ad writing, ideation, VO production, image creation, video creation, and workflow improvement.
  • Guide the team in using AI tools to improve speed, quality, and efficiency.
  • Continuously explore new AI tools and workflows for promo production.
  • Ensure AI-assisted outputs are reviewed for storytelling quality, cultural accuracy, and production readiness.

8. Market & Audience Understanding

  • Apply strong understanding of Brazilian consumer behavior, content consumption habits, and market trends.
  • Ensure promos feel native, relevant, and compelling for Brazilian audiences.
  • Stay updated on digital ads, audio entertainment, trailer formats, and performance creative trends.


Qualifications


  • Degree in Filmmaking, Marketing, Advertising, Media, Communications, or a related field.
  • 8+ years of experience in ad creation, promo creation, trailer development, marketing creatives, ad copywriting, or performance creative production.
  • Strong understanding of marketing, ad storytelling, promo creation, and audience engagement.
  • Experience leading creative or production teams, including writers, editors, sound engineers, or external vendors.
  • Excellent command of English and Brazilian Portuguese.
  • Strong understanding of Brazilian consumer behavior, content consumption patterns, and cultural nuances.
  • Experience working with dubbing agencies, VO artists, production teams, or post-production vendors.
  • Skilled in GenAI tools for writing, VO production, image creation, video creation, and creative workflow improvement.
  • Ability to create SOPs, trackers, review systems, and scalable creative processes.
  • Strong analytical ability to review ad performance and convert insights into actionable creative reworks.
  • Excellent communication, stakeholder management, and leadership skills.
  • Strategic thinker with strong ownership and business growth orientation.
  • Understanding of performance marketing on Meta and UAC is a plus.


Ideal Candidate


The ideal candidate is a creative leader who understands storytelling, promo production, and performance-driven advertising. They should be able to lead a multi-functional team, manage dubbing partners, maintain strong quality control, and deliver high-quality promo assets at scale.

They should have strong knowledge of Brazilian audiences, excellent creative judgment, hands-on production understanding, and the ability to turn performance feedback into clear creative action.


Language requirements

  • Fluent Portugese
  • Professional working proficiency in English


This role will be working with stakeholders in English on a regular basis.


Salary for this position is R$ 7,000 - $10,000 BRL.

About Pocket FM


Pocket FM is the world’s largest audio-series platform, where powerful stories travel effortlessly across languages, cultures, and continents. From India and the US to Europe and beyond, we are redefining how stories are created, discovered, and experienced across the globe, without screens.


At our core, we are an AI-powered entertainment company with a deeply human-first philosophy. We believe technology should amplify creativity. Our proprietary AI systems work alongside writers, voice artists, and creative teams to help stories scale globally, faster, smarter, and with cultural depth and emotional integrity intact.


Today, Pocket FM is home to a vibrant community of 250+ million listeners, 300,000+ creators, and 100,000+ audio series. With over 140 billion minutes streamed annually, we have emerged as one of the fastest-growing media-tech companies in the world, and we are just getting started. We operate at a massive global scale, but with a startup mindset: curious, fast-moving, and deeply owner-driven. At Pocket FM, teams are encouraged to think boldly, move with intent, and build for long-term impact as we shape the future of audio-first storytelling worldwide.


Role Overview


We are looking for a creative and execution-focused Promo Team Lead to lead the end-to-end creation of promotional ads, trailers, and performance creatives for Pocket FM audio series in the Brazilian market.


As a Promo Team Lead, you will manage a team of promo writers, sound engineers, video editors, and dubbing partners to create high-quality promotional ads for Pocket FM audio series.


The role requires strong understanding of promo creation, ad storytelling, localization, dubbing workflows, quality control, team management, and creative optimization. You will oversee fresh promo creation, adaptation of ads from other geographies into Brazilian Portuguese, production quality, timely delivery, and reworks for ads that are not meeting performance benchmarks.


Key Responsibilities


1. Team Leadership & Creative Direction

  • Lead and guide promo writers, sound engineers, video editors, and external dubbing partners.
  • Provide creative direction across writing, dubbing, audio mixing, video editing, and final delivery.
  • Ensure the team is well-utilized, motivated, and aligned with business and creative goals.
  • Build a high-ownership culture focused on quality, speed, and performance.

2. Promo Creation & Localization

  • Oversee the creation of fresh promo ads, trailers, and long-form promotional scripts for audio series.
  • Adapt successful ads from other geographies into Brazilian Portuguese.
  • Ensure all promos are culturally relevant, emotionally engaging, and suitable for Brazilian audiences.
  • Guide the team on hooks, story setup, emotional beats, cliffhangers, and audience entry points.

3. Production & Quality Control

  • Own the end-to-end promo production process from brief to final asset delivery.
  • Quality check every stage, including writing, dubbing, audio mixing, video creation, and final output.
  • Review scripts, VO/dubbing output, audio edits, video cuts, captions, and final creatives.
  • Ensure every asset meets Pocket FM’s creative, language, production, and performance standards.

4. Dubbing Agency Management

  • Identify, evaluate, and onboard dubbing agencies for Brazilian Portuguese production.
  • Coordinate with agencies for script handover, voice casting, recording, revisions, and delivery.
  • Review dubbing output for pronunciation, emotion, pacing, tone, and character fit.
  • Track agency timelines, pending deliverables, feedback loops, and final submissions.

5. Performance Reworks & Optimization

  • Review ads that are not meeting benchmark metrics and identify key creative issues.
  • Create detailed and actionable rework hypotheses to improve ad performance.
  • Suggest improvements such as stronger hooks, sharper conflicts, better pacing, improved localization, or revised visuals.
  • Guide the team in creating alternate openings, new versions, and stronger creative angles.
  • Apply campaign learnings to improve future promo concepts and execution.

6. Process, Tracking & Reporting

  • Maintain show-level trackers for all ads being written, adapted, dubbed, edited, reviewed, and delivered.
  • Track ownership, status, timelines, delays, feedback, and final delivery for each asset.
  • Share weekly progress reports with the India team and relevant stakeholders.
  • Create SOPs, checklists, and workflows to avoid leakages across the production process.

7. AI Tool Adoption

  • Use GenAI tools for ad writing, ideation, VO production, image creation, video creation, and workflow improvement.
  • Guide the team in using AI tools to improve speed, quality, and efficiency.
  • Continuously explore new AI tools and workflows for promo production.
  • Ensure AI-assisted outputs are reviewed for storytelling quality, cultural accuracy, and production readiness.

8. Market & Audience Understanding

  • Apply strong understanding of Brazilian consumer behavior, content consumption habits, and market trends.
  • Ensure promos feel native, relevant, and compelling for Brazilian audiences.
  • Stay updated on digital ads, audio entertainment, trailer formats, and performance creative trends.


Qualifications


  • Degree in Filmmaking, Marketing, Advertising, Media, Communications, or a related field.
  • 8+ years of experience in ad creation, promo creation, trailer development, marketing creatives, ad copywriting, or performance creative production.
  • Strong understanding of marketing, ad storytelling, promo creation, and audience engagement.
  • Experience leading creative or production teams, including writers, editors, sound engineers, or external vendors.
  • Excellent command of English and Brazilian Portuguese.
  • Strong understanding of Brazilian consumer behavior, content consumption patterns, and cultural nuances.
  • Experience working with dubbing agencies, VO artists, production teams, or post-production vendors.
  • Skilled in GenAI tools for writing, VO production, image creation, video creation, and creative workflow improvement.
  • Ability to create SOPs, trackers, review systems, and scalable creative processes.
  • Strong analytical ability to review ad performance and convert insights into actionable creative reworks.
  • Excellent communication, stakeholder management, and leadership skills.
  • Strategic thinker with strong ownership and business growth orientation.
  • Understanding of performance marketing on Meta and UAC is a plus.


Ideal Candidate


The ideal candidate is a creative leader who understands storytelling, promo production, and performance-driven advertising. They should be able to lead a multi-functional team, manage dubbing partners, maintain strong quality control, and deliver high-quality promo assets at scale.

They should have strong knowledge of Brazilian audiences, excellent creative judgment, hands-on production understanding, and the ability to turn performance feedback into clear creative action.


Language requirements

  • Fluent Portugese
  • Professional working proficiency in English


This role will be working with stakeholders in English on a regular basis.


Salary for this position is R$ 7,000 - $10,000 BRL.

title: Senior Performance Governance Analyst (KPI & Service Excellence)

Estamos em busca de um(a) Senior Performance Governance Analyst (KPI & Service Excellence) para atuar na estruturação, evolução e governança do framework de indicadores de excelência de serviços do Centro de Serviços Compartilhados (CSC).

  • Garantir padronização metodológica, clareza conceitual e rastreabilidade dos indicadores;
  • Atuar na definição de conceitos, fórmulas, regras de cálculo e critérios de análise;
  • Identificar e priorizar lacunas de mensuração nos pilares de custo, prazo e qualidade;
  • Conduzir ciclos de validação junto às áreas de negócio e stakeholders;
  • Atuar na priorização e gestão do backlog de indicadores considerando impacto e viabilidade;
  • Apoiar a construção de frameworks de governança e acompanhamento de performance;
  • Monitorar a maturidade dos indicadores e propor evoluções contínuas;
  • Realizar interface com times de BI e dados para implementação das métricas;
  • Traduzir demandas estratégicas e operacionais em indicadores acionáveis e mensuráveis;
  • Atuar de forma consultiva, apoiando a tomada de decisão baseada em dados.


Requisitos e qualificações

Obrigatórios:

  • Graduação ou pós-graduação em TI, Engenharia, Estatística, Administração ou áreas correlatas;
  • Vivência com definição, estruturação e governança de KPIs e métricas operacionais;
  • Experiência em atuação com stakeholders e áreas de negócio;
  • Conhecimento em frameworks de performance e gestão de indicadores;
  • Capacidade de atuar tanto em nível estratégico quanto em detalhamento conceitual de indicadores.


Desejáveis:

  • Experiência com CSC (Centro de Serviços Compartilhados);
  • Conhecimentos em ferramentas de BI (Power BI, Tableau, etc.);
  • Experiência em ambientes de Data & Analytics;
  • Conhecimento em metodologias de melhoria contínua (Lean, Six Sigma);
  • Vivência em projetos com grandes empresas ou ambientes complexos.

title: Strategy & Operations Manager (Revenue)
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Strategy & Operations Manager (Revenue) em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

About Revolut

People deserve more from their money. More visibility, more control, and more freedom. Since 2015, Revolut has been on a mission to deliver just that. Our powerhouse of products — including spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more — help our 75+ million customers get more from their money every day.

As we continue our lightning-fast growth, 2 things are essential to our success: our people and our culture. In recognition of our outstanding employee experience, we've been certified as a Great Place to Work™. So far, we have 13,000+ people working around the world, from our offices and remotely, to help us achieve our mission. And we're looking for more brilliant people. People who love building great products, redefining success, and turning the complexity of a chaotic world into the simplicity of a beautiful solution.

About the role

At Revolut, Operations means problem-solving at scale. Our team tackles the company’s toughest challenges with speed, precision, and creativity. They design systems that unlock efficiency and power global growth.

We're looking for a Revenue Operations Manager to work on high-impact initiatives throughout the business, using insight to solve challenges, scale processes, and deliver better outcomes for our customers.

Watch this video from our team members about what goes into being a Strategy & Operations Manager at Revolut.

Up to shape what's next in finance? Let’s get in touch.

What you’ll be doing

  • Building and optimising scalable processes to continue Revolut's hyper-growth
  • Leading and executing core infrastructure projects end to end
  • Exploring and defining which projects the team should prioritise, and setting a timeline to reach goals quickly
  • Searching for new features to provide a seamless customer experience
  • Managing critical vendor relationships and building performance tracking systems
  • Developing strategic supply chain partnerships and negotiating commercial terms

What you'll need

  • At least a 2:1 degree from a top university
  • 2+ years of work experience in a fast-paced environment
  • A solid track record of taking ownership and leading complex projects
  • The ability to break complex problems into smaller ones
  • To enjoy working with data
  • Natural curiosity and a will to make an impact
  • An interest in the financial industry

Nice to have

  • Experience coding with SQL, Python, and/or R

Compensation range

  • Krakow: PLN15,700 - PLN35,800 gross monthly*
  • Poland: PLN15,700 - PLN35,800 gross monthly*
  • Other locations: Compensation will be discussed during the interview process

*Final compensation will be determined based on the candidate's qualifications, skills, and previous experience

title: Associate II, Pharmacovigilance - Brazil - Remote
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Associate II, Pharmacovigilance - Brazil - Remote em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

What the Associate II, Pharmacovigilance does at Worldwide


Responsible for the collection, processing, evaluation and reporting of incoming Serious Adverse Event (SAE) data according to applicable regulatory guidelines/requirements, Worldwide Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) and project specific instructions. Serves as Lead PV Associate on moderate to large sized studies that are moderate to complex in scope of work with moderate support from senior staff.


What you will do


  • Author Safety Management Plan for assigned studies
  • Attend and present at Investigator Meetings
  • Review incoming SAE data for completeness and accuracy
  • Perform data entry in the Safety Database and/or complete applicable tracking of incoming safety information
  • Perform QC of SAEs processed by other PV Associates
  • Generate regulatory reports and perform safety submissions as needed


What you will bring to the role


  • Strong understanding of medical and scientific terminology, of the principles of clinical assessment of adverse drug events, of international regulations and of reporting requirements
  • Strong understanding of computer technology, and management of relational database systems, including extraction of data
  • Excellent organizational skills and ability to handle multiple competing priorities within tight timelines
  • Consistently demonstrates commitment, dependability, cooperation, adaptability and flexibility in executing daily tasks and responsibilities


Your experience


  • Minimum of 3 years of pharmacovigilance experience (pre-approval clinical trials)
  • Bachelor’s degree in science related field, nursing or equivalent combination of relevant education and experience
  • Computer literacy and strong working knowledge of MS Office applications (Excel, PowerPoint, Word)
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills
  • Excellent organization skills and attention to detail
  • Demonstrated ability to handle multiple competing priorities while adhering to applicable timelines
  • Ability to work independently, prioritize work effectively and work successfully in matrix team environment
  • Ability and willingness for potential limited travel (domestic and international) as needed (attend Investigator Meeting, project kick-off meeting and/or bid defense meeting)
  • Fluent in written and verbal English

title: Project Manager
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Project Manager em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Ten16 Creative is looking for a mid-level Project Manager based in Brazil to help keep our creative work clear, organized, and moving forward. Ten16 is a creative partner for technology-driven companies, helping teams turn complex products into clear, market-ready brand, campaign, design, web, video, and motion experiences. Our clients operate across areas such as AI, SaaS, gaming, entertainment, consumer electronics, connected hardware, and B2B technology.


This is a remote contractor position for someone who is experienced enough to manage multiple moving pieces with confidence, but still hands-on, adaptable, and eager to grow with a fast-moving creative team. The right person will bring structure to creative work without slowing it down. They will help coordinate timelines, deliverables, client communication, internal reviews, production details, and day-to-day follow-through across projects that often involve strategy, design, writing, motion, video, web, and campaign development.


About Ten16 Creative

Ten16 Creative is a global creative studio with roots in the United States and São Paulo. We help tech-driven companies make complex products easier to understand, trust, and bring to market. Our work spans brand identity, campaign development, design systems, web design, presentations, marketing assets, video, motion, 3D animation, AI-powered production, and creative leadership.


We work with companies that need a creative partner who can bring clarity, consistency, and structure to sophisticated products. Our clients have included technology, AI, SaaS, gaming, entertainment, and consumer electronics brands, with representative work across companies and projects in various tech-driven spaces.


About the Role

The Project Manager will be responsible for helping Ten16 plan, coordinate, and deliver creative projects from kickoff through final delivery. This person will work closely with creative directors, designers, producers, writers, motion teams, developers, and clients to make sure everyone understands what needs to happen, when it needs to happen, and what is required to deliver excellent work.


This role is ideal for someone who has already worked in an agency, creative studio, production company, marketing team, or digital product environment and understands how creative work moves from brief to execution. The role does not require senior-level account leadership, but it does require organization, fluent English and Portuguese communication skills, and the ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously.


You will manage active project timelines and ensure that milestones, deliverables, meetings, and reviews are clearly documented and communicated. You will help turn creative scopes into practical schedules, making sure that internal team members understand priorities and that clients understand what is needed from them to keep projects moving.


You will coordinate daily and weekly project activity across brand, design, web, video, motion, campaign, and presentation work. This includes assigning or tracking tasks, following up on open items, preparing meeting agendas, documenting decisions, and making sure feedback is captured accurately. You will also help maintain project management tools, shared folders, project boards, calendars, and production documents so the team always has a reliable source of truth.


You will support client-facing communication in English with professionalism and clarity. This may include sending status updates, recapping meetings, organizing feedback, preparing for presentations, and helping the team stay ahead of deadlines. Because Ten16 works with technology-driven companies, you should be comfortable working on projects where the subject matter may be complex, technical, or still evolving.


You will help protect the quality of the work by making sure deliverables are complete, organized, properly labeled, and ready for review or delivery. You will not be expected to creative-direct the work, but you should have a strong eye for detail and enough creative production experience to recognize when something is missing, unclear, or not ready to send.


Qualifications

The ideal candidate has approximately 3–5 years of experience in project management, creative production, account coordination, marketing operations, agency operations, or a related role. They should have experience managing creative deliverables and coordinating cross-functional teams in a remote environment.


They must be located in Brazil and must be fluent in both Portuguese and English. English fluency is essential because the role will involve written and spoken communication with U.S.-based team members and clients. Portuguese fluency is equally important for collaboration with Brazil-based team members and vendors.
