title: Executive Assistant
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Executive Assistant em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Executive Assistant to a US CEO — Sales-Driven, Self-Starters Only

Read this whole thing before you apply. It's a filter.

We place Executive Assistants with US home-service business owners. You won't be a task-rabbit. You'll be the CEO's right hand — the person who moves the needle on whatever the business needs that week.


Your #1 job: make sure deals close. Appointment setting, direct sales, follow-up that doesn't quit. From there it widens — hiring providers, dispatching, customer satisfaction, finding new ways to grow the business. We're not hiring an assistant. We're hiring a mini-CEO who makes the big CEO's life bigger.


This role is for people who take the reins. Nobody is going to hand you a checklist every morning. You see the gap, you close the gap. If you need to be told what to do next, stop reading — this will frustrate both of us.


The pay grows when you do:

  • Start at $1,000/mo
  • Hit your first KPI → $1,250/mo
  • Hit the next → $1,400/mo
  • Performance bonuses from the business owner on top — up to $400/mo more

The ceiling moves because you move it. We don't cap people who produce.


What you need to have:

  • Fluent, clear, neutral English — easy for a US homeowner to understand on a call
  • Proven sales or appointment-setting background (show us the receipts)
  • Comfortable owning a number, not just doing tasks
  • Cold calling is a plus, not a must


The non-negotiables — apply only if these are a yes:

  • Available across all US time zones (PST/CST/MST/EST)
  • Up to 50 hours/week. This is firm.
  • Saturday mornings when the business needs it
  • Comfortable with Hubstaff time tracking. We use it for transparency, not to micromanage or punish — that's not how we operate. But it's part of the job.


If you read the hours and the ownership bar and felt more interested, not less — you're who we're looking for. Hit Easy Apply. If you're a fit, we'll come back to you fast — we move quick when we find the right person.

title: Sr. Software Engineer II - Data Solutions & Measurement
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Sr. Software Engineer II - Data Solutions & Measurement em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Cint is a global software leader in technology-enabled digital insights and research technology. The Cint platform automates the insights-gathering process so that companies can gain access to insights faster with unparalleled scale. Cint has one of the world’s largest consumer networks for digital survey-based research, made up of over 239 million engaged respondents across more than 130 countries. Over 4,600 insights-driven companies use Cint to accelerate how they gather consumer insights and supercharge business growth.

Job Description

The Team

The Cint Technology team is looking for a Senior Software Engineer II to join our international Measurement team. This position is for a software engineer who likes challenges. Our business has been doubling in the last few years, and so our systems need to scale to accommodate this growth.

What You Will Do

Our ideal candidate considers themselves among the highly technical and likes to push the limits of their knowledge and experience every day. In this role, you will work on designing, implementing, scaling, and maintaining the code that powers our production systems. With great freedom to innovate, you will play a key role in world-class research building the next generation of Cint products.

This is a remote opportunity for all over the country!

Qualifications

  • Strong and seasoned hands-on professional backend software development experience

  • Degree in Computer Science or related field

  • Proficient programming skills in Java

  • Comfortable maintaining Python code legacy

  • Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines and testing frameworks

  • Experience with API integration

  • Experience with AWS, Docker, Kubernetes, SQL

  • Comfortable dealing with system complexity

  • Great sense of ownership

  • You enjoy pushing the limits of your knowledge and experience every day

  • Outstanding problem-solving and analytical skills

  • Enjoys working as part of a team and as a mentor


Nice to have:

  • Spring framework, microservices

  • Background in data analytics tools such as Spark, Hive, Databricks, or similar

Additional Information


Our Values

Collaboration is our superpower

  • We uncover rich perspectives across the world
  • Success happens together
  • We deliver across borders.

Innovation is in our blood

  • We’re pioneers in our industry
  • Our curiosity is insatiable
  • We bring the best ideas to life.

We do what we say

  • We’re accountable for our work and actions
  • Excellence comes as standard
  • We’re open, honest and kind, always.

We are caring

  • We learn from each other’s experiences
  • Stop and listen; every opinion matters
  • We embrace diversity, equity and inclusion.


More About Cint

We’re proud to be recognised in Newsweek’s 2025 Global Top 100 Most Loved Workplaces®, reflecting our commitment to a culture of trust, respect, and employee growth.

In June 2021, Cint acquired Berlin-based GapFish – the world’s largest ISO certified online panel community in the DACH region – and in January 2022, completed the acquisition of US-based Lucid – a programmatic research technology platform that provides access to first-party survey data in over 110 countries.

Cint Group AB (publ), listed on Nasdaq Stockholm, this growth has made Cint a strong global platform with teams across its many global offices, including Stockholm, London, New York, New Orleans, Singapore, Tokyo and Sydney. (


Additionally, in a world of AI, we want our candidates to understand our approach to the use of AI during the interview and hiring process, so we'd appreciate you reading our AI usage guide.

description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Desenvolvedor AEM, Senior em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Who Are We.


Newfold Digital is a leading web technology company serving nearly seven million customers globally. Established in 2021 through the combination of leading web services providers Endurance Web Presence and Web.com Group, our portfolio of brands includes: Bluehost, BigRock, ResellerClub, CrazyDomains, HostGator, Network Solutions, Register.com, Web.com and many others.


We help customers of all sizes build a digital presence that delivers results. With our extensive product offerings and personalized support, we take pride in collaborating with our customers to serve their online presence needs.


What you’ll do & how you’ll make your mark.

  • Develop and maintain reusable front-end components in Adobe Experience Manager (AEM).
  • Work with AEM components and templates, including integrating front-end code with AEM's rendering system.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including designers, back-end developers to deliver digital experiences.


Who you are & what you’ll need to succeed.

  • Advanced English skills .
  • Strong proficiency in HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript/TypeScript, and responsive web design principles.
  • Experience integrating Front-end code with AEM components, templates, and workflows.
  • Familiarity with AEM Sightly (HTL) and Sling models and AEM ecosystem.
  • Excellent communication skills and ability to collaborate effectively in a team environment.


Why you'll love us

  • We offer a 100% remote position with a monthly home office allowance of R$180.00 and an additional allowance for purchasing items for your office.
  • We provide Meal Vouchers or Food Vouchers worth R$44.55 per working day.
  • Health and dental insurance with no co-payment for employees.
  • Well-being program: Gympass, online meditation, and telemedicine!
  • Do you have a dog, cat, rabbit, hamster, goat, turtle, or even a mini dragon? We have a partnership for pet health insurance!
  • Educational platform: you can pursue undergraduate and graduate degrees, language courses (and much more!) at over 100 educational institutions for a very affordable price!
  • Life insurance.
  • Free website hosting.

Liderar o desenvolvimento e a implementação de soluções de inteligência artificial, garantindo a inovação e a excelência técnica.

title: Creative Strategist
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Creative Strategist em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

We are a leading brand in health supplements for women over 40. Our mission is to improve the quality of life for women going through menopause by solving real, everyday challenges—weight gain, hot flashes, insomnia, mood shifts, and more.


We’re looking for a Creative Strategist with strong persuasive advertising and copywriting expertise to own the ideation and messaging that drives performance. You’ll turn customer insights, performance data, and market awareness into high-converting creative angles, scripts, and messaging systems that scale.


Responsibilities

Creative Strategy

  • Contribute to the development of creative strategy for paid social, grounded in direct-response principles
  • Translate performance data, customer research, and competitive insights into effective copy frameworks and angles
  • Support the creation of ad concepts and scalable creative approaches
  • Participate in brainstorming and help shape a testing roadmap of angles, messages, and formats based on clear hypotheses
  • Help maintain creative standards to ensure consistent brand voice and persuasive quality across ads, landing pages, and funnels


Performance & Media Buying Integration

  • Use platform learnings and audience behavior to shape creative testing and copy direction.
  • Build feedback loops so creative evolves weekly based on performance data across ads


AI & Creative Innovation

  • Experience leveraging AI tools to accelerate creative research and performance testing.
  • Proven ability to prepare structured briefs and prompts for AI-generated ad creatives (scripts, hooks, visuals, UGC-style ads).


Qualifications

  • Experience in creative strategy, performance creative, or e-commerce marketing.
  • Hands-on experience with direct-response copywriting
  • Direct experience with women’s wellness, supplements, or health-related products strongly preferred.
  • Proven ability to prepare structured briefs/prompts for AI-generated ad creatives (e.g., scripts, hooks, visuals, UGC-style ads).
  • Strong portfolio of paid social creative with proven ROI.
  • Excellent communication and cross-functional collaboration skills.


Working hours

  • 6am - 2pm EST (Monday - Friday)
  • Fully-remote


Compensation

  • $3,500 to $5,000/month


If you think you might be a good fit, please apply.

title: Executive Assistant
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Executive Assistant em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Executive Assistant to a US CEO — Sales-Driven, Self-Starters Only

Read this whole thing before you apply. It's a filter.

We place Executive Assistants with US home-service business owners. You won't be a task-rabbit. You'll be the CEO's right hand — the person who moves the needle on whatever the business needs that week.


Your #1 job: make sure deals close. Appointment setting, direct sales, follow-up that doesn't quit. From there it widens — hiring providers, dispatching, customer satisfaction, finding new ways to grow the business. We're not hiring an assistant. We're hiring a mini-CEO who makes the big CEO's life bigger.


This role is for people who take the reins. Nobody is going to hand you a checklist every morning. You see the gap, you close the gap. If you need to be told what to do next, stop reading — this will frustrate both of us.


The pay grows when you do:

  • Start at $1,000/mo
  • Hit your first KPI → $1,250/mo
  • Hit the next → $1,400/mo
  • Performance bonuses from the business owner on top — up to $400/mo more

The ceiling moves because you move it. We don't cap people who produce.


What you need to have:

  • Fluent, clear, neutral English — easy for a US homeowner to understand on a call
  • Proven sales or appointment-setting background (show us the receipts)
  • Comfortable owning a number, not just doing tasks
  • Cold calling is a plus, not a must


The non-negotiables — apply only if these are a yes:

  • Available across all US time zones (PST/CST/MST/EST)
  • Up to 50 hours/week. This is firm.
  • Saturday mornings when the business needs it
  • Comfortable with Hubstaff time tracking. We use it for transparency, not to micromanage or punish — that's not how we operate. But it's part of the job.


If you read the hours and the ownership bar and felt more interested, not less — you're who we're looking for. Hit Easy Apply. If you're a fit, we'll come back to you fast — we move quick when we find the right person.

title: Sr. Software Engineer II - Data Solutions & Measurement
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Sr. Software Engineer II - Data Solutions & Measurement em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Cint is a global software leader in technology-enabled digital insights and research technology. The Cint platform automates the insights-gathering process so that companies can gain access to insights faster with unparalleled scale. Cint has one of the world’s largest consumer networks for digital survey-based research, made up of over 239 million engaged respondents across more than 130 countries. Over 4,600 insights-driven companies use Cint to accelerate how they gather consumer insights and supercharge business growth.

Job Description

The Team

The Cint Technology team is looking for a Senior Software Engineer II to join our international Measurement team. This position is for a software engineer who likes challenges. Our business has been doubling in the last few years, and so our systems need to scale to accommodate this growth.

What You Will Do

Our ideal candidate considers themselves among the highly technical and likes to push the limits of their knowledge and experience every day. In this role, you will work on designing, implementing, scaling, and maintaining the code that powers our production systems. With great freedom to innovate, you will play a key role in world-class research building the next generation of Cint products.

This is a remote opportunity for all over the country!

Qualifications

  • Strong and seasoned hands-on professional backend software development experience

  • Degree in Computer Science or related field

  • Proficient programming skills in Java

  • Comfortable maintaining Python code legacy

  • Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines and testing frameworks

  • Experience with API integration

  • Experience with AWS, Docker, Kubernetes, SQL

  • Comfortable dealing with system complexity

  • Great sense of ownership

  • You enjoy pushing the limits of your knowledge and experience every day

  • Outstanding problem-solving and analytical skills

  • Enjoys working as part of a team and as a mentor


Nice to have:

  • Spring framework, microservices

  • Background in data analytics tools such as Spark, Hive, Databricks, or similar

Additional Information


Our Values

Collaboration is our superpower

  • We uncover rich perspectives across the world
  • Success happens together
  • We deliver across borders.

Innovation is in our blood

  • We’re pioneers in our industry
  • Our curiosity is insatiable
  • We bring the best ideas to life.

We do what we say

  • We’re accountable for our work and actions
  • Excellence comes as standard
  • We’re open, honest and kind, always.

We are caring

  • We learn from each other’s experiences
  • Stop and listen; every opinion matters
  • We embrace diversity, equity and inclusion.


More About Cint

We’re proud to be recognised in Newsweek’s 2025 Global Top 100 Most Loved Workplaces®, reflecting our commitment to a culture of trust, respect, and employee growth.

In June 2021, Cint acquired Berlin-based GapFish – the world’s largest ISO certified online panel community in the DACH region – and in January 2022, completed the acquisition of US-based Lucid – a programmatic research technology platform that provides access to first-party survey data in over 110 countries.

Cint Group AB (publ), listed on Nasdaq Stockholm, this growth has made Cint a strong global platform with teams across its many global offices, including Stockholm, London, New York, New Orleans, Singapore, Tokyo and Sydney. (

title: Operations Support System Engineer
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Operations Support System Engineer em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

About us

We’re a U.S.-based healthcare software company building workflow and AI tools for a complex, high-

impact corner of healthcare administration. Small, technical team. We automate anything that happens

twice.


The role

If a process repeats, your job is to automate it.

You’ll own the systems behind our internal operations, sales, onboarding, and executive support — from the SaaS stack to the Zoho ecosystem to the automations that tie them together. You’ll be expected to take a business problem, design a solution, ship it, and keep it running without hand-holding.


What you’ll own


Business systems & administration

• Manage user access, permissions, and subscriptions across our SaaS stack.

• Provision and deprovision accounts cleanly, with security and auditability in mind.

• Keep the environment organized, documented, and ready to scale.


Zoho architecture

• Design and maintain our Zoho ecosystem (CRM, Books, Analytics, and adjacent apps).

• Build systems that match how the business actually works — no forced workarounds.

• Improve data quality, reporting, and operational visibility.


Automation & AI workflows

• Build no-code and low-code automations in Make, Zapier, and similar tools.

• Hunt down repetitive workflows and eliminate them.

• Design AI-assisted processes that make work faster, more consistent, and more accurate.


Operational engineering

• Understand how leads, sales, billing, onboarding, and customer ops connect.

• Build systems that reflect those flows end-to-end.

• Be the human-in-the-loop when judgment or exception handling is required.


You should have

• Hands-on experience building operational systems on no-code / low-code platforms.

• Fluency with Make, Zapier, or equivalent automation tools.

• Real experience using modern AI tools inside production workflows.

• Excellent written and spoken English.

• The instinct to work independently and figure things out.


Bonus points for

• Zoho CRM / Books / Analytics experience.

• A track record supporting sales, ops, or CS teams.

• A portfolio of automations or systems actively running today.

• Startup or fast-moving environment experience.


What success looks like (first 90 days)

• Measurable reduction in manual operational work.

• Cleaner, better-documented internal systems.

• Automations that run reliably without constant babysitting.

• You’re the clear owner of our operational tech stack.


Logistics

• Full-time contractor

• Fully remote

• Compensation: R$6,000/month


How to apply

Send a short Loom walking us through one system or automation you built end-to-end. Cover:

1. The problem.

2. The solution you designed.

3. The tools you used.

  • We care more about what you’ve built than what’s on your résumé.

title: Desenvolvedor front-end SR
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Desenvolvedor front-end SR em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Desenvolvedor(a) Front-end Sênior | React + Mobile Híbrido


Buscamos um(a) Desenvolvedor(a) Front-end Sênior para atuar em projetos estratégicos de grande escala, com foco no desenvolvimento de experiências digitais modernas, performáticas e integradas aos ecossistemas mobile Android e iOS.


Buscamos profissionais que possuam sólida experiência em React e que tenham atuado em aplicações híbridas, compreendendo os desafios da integração entre aplicações web e componentes nativos mobile.


Principais Responsabilidades

Desenvolver e evoluir aplicações Front-end utilizando React e TypeScript.

Construir interfaces modernas, escaláveis e com alta preocupação em performance e usabilidade.

Atuar na integração entre aplicações React e ambientes mobile por meio de WebViews.

Trabalhar em conjunto com equipes Android e iOS para implementação de funcionalidades e resolução de problemas de integração.

Participar de definições arquiteturais, revisões de código e disseminação de boas práticas de desenvolvimento.

Garantir qualidade de código por meio de testes, monitoramento e observabilidade.


Requisitos Obrigatórios

Experiência sólida como Desenvolvedor(a) Front-end Sênior.

Domínio de React, TypeScript e JavaScript moderno (ES6+).

Experiência com arquitetura de aplicações Front-end de grande porte.

Conhecimento em consumo e integração de APIs REST.

Vivência com testes automatizados e boas práticas de desenvolvimento.

Experiência com Git e metodologias ágeis.


Diferenciais Importantes

Experiência com aplicações híbridas utilizando WebView.

title: Engenheiro de dados S
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Engenheiro de dados S em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Quem Somos

A Dexian, lançada em 2023, tem presença global e traz consigo quase 30 anos de experiência através de suas companhias legadas, principalmente da combinação da DISYS e Signature Consultants.


Iniciamos no Brasil 2007 como DISYS e, de lá para cá, conquistamos mais de 50 clientes de diferentes setores da economia. Como Dexian, passamos a ser uma das maiores empresas de contratação e solução de TI e estamos liderando a indústria por meio de entrega de serviços exclusivos que combina escala global, recursos de serviço completo e agilidade tática para modernizar modelos de contratação, avançar em soluções de mão-de-obra e transformar a infraestrutura tecnológica. Contamos com escritórios estrategicamente localizados em quatro grandes capitais: Curitiba (PR), Porto Alegre (RS), Rio de Janeiro (RJ) e São Paulo (SP). Assim, conseguimos nos manter próximos dos nossos clientes e consultores. Também somos uma Minority Owner Company e nos sentimos orgulhosos de termos nascido na diversidade.


O que esperar de nós

Pessoas estão no centro de nossa estratégia e compõem o nosso maior capital. Temos compromisso de atrair, reter os maiores e melhores talentos e construir conexões reais para a vida. Por isso, atuamos como ponte entre profissionais altamente qualificados e oportunidades consistentes e prósperas. Acreditamos que, trazer o talento, a tecnologia e as organizações certas juntos, ajuda a desbloquear resultados transformadores e alcançar novos níveis de sucessos para os clientes que atendemos e os consultores que contratamos. E para isso, cinco valores fundamentais nos guiam: Integridade, Transparência, Autenticidade, Engenhosidade e Empatia. Compartilha dos mesmos valores, aqui é seu lugar! Que tal desenvolver sua carreira conosco?


Na Dexian, valorizamos a diversidade.

Acreditamos que diferentes perspectivas, experiências e trajetórias impulsionam a inovação e fortalecem conexões. Por isso, nosso processo de contratação é inclusivo, aberto a candidatos de todas as identidades, habilidades e histórias. Aqui, o que importa é o talento.


Sobre a posição

Como parte de uma equipe global de tecnologia, o(a) Engenheiro(a) de Dados Sênior atuará no desenvolvimento, manutenção e evolução de produtos de dados em ambiente Cloud. O profissional será responsável por projetar e implementar soluções de engenharia de dados, garantindo qualidade, confiabilidade e escalabilidade dos dados utilizados pela organização.


A posição exige forte atuação em projetos de dados utilizando plataformas como Azure e Snowflake, além de colaboração constante com arquitetos, times ágeis e stakeholders de negócio para entrega de soluções analíticas de alto valor.


Principais Responsabilidades

• Projetar, desenvolver e manter soluções de engenharia de dados em ambiente Cloud.

• Desenvolver pipelines de dados batch e streaming utilizando plataformas Azure e Snowflake.

• Implementar processos de extração, transformação e carga de dados (ETL/ELT) provenientes de múltiplas fontes.

• Garantir a qualidade, governança e integridade dos dados ao longo de todo o ciclo de processamento.

• Desenvolver e manter soluções utilizando Snowflake, dbt e tecnologias do ecossistema Azure.

• Construir e otimizar consultas SQL, procedures e rotinas de processamento de dados.

• Implementar integrações entre diferentes sistemas e fontes de dados corporativas.

• Participar de provas de conceito (POCs), avaliações técnicas e demonstrações de novas tecnologias.

Colaboração e Entrega de Projetos

• Trabalhar em conjunto com equipes de negócio, arquitetos de soluções e times técnicos para levantamento de requisitos e definição de soluções.

• Traduzir necessidades de negócio em modelos de dados, fluxos automatizados e soluções escaláveis.

• Garantir aderência às melhores práticas de arquitetura, desenvolvimento, governança e segurança de dados.

• Participar ativamente de cerimônias ágeis e processos de melhoria contínua.

DevOps e Qualidade

• Atuar seguindo práticas de CI/CD, DevOps e padrões de desenvolvimento estabelecidos pela organização.

• Utilizar ferramentas de versionamento e gestão de código-fonte, como GitHub e Azure DevOps.

• Apoiar processos de automação, testes e monitoramento das soluções desenvolvidas.

• Contribuir para a evolução contínua da plataforma de dados e das práticas de engenharia adotadas pela equipe.


Requisitos Obrigatórios

• Experiência sólida em Engenharia de Dados (mínimo de 5 anos).

• Experiência prática com Snowflake.

• Conhecimento sólido em SQL, incluindo consultas complexas e stored procedures.

• Conhecimento sólido em dbt (Data Build Tool).

• Experiência na construção e manutenção de pipelines ETL/ELT em ambiente Cloud.

• Experiência com serviços Azure, incluindo ADF, Functions, Event Hub e Azure DevOps.

• Conhecimento em Python para desenvolvimento e automação de processos de dados.

• Conhecimento de modelagem de dados

• Experiência com práticas de CI/CD, DevOps e versionamento de código utilizando GitHub.

• Conhecimento em metodologias ágeis (Scrum e/ou Kanban).

• Inglês avançado para comunicação em ambiente corporativo global.

Diferenciais

• Experiência com ferramentas de replicação de dados, como Qlik Replicate, SLT ou Click.

• Experiência em projetos de Data & Analytics.

• Conhecimento em SQL Server e otimização de consultas.

• Conhecimento em ferramentas de visualização de dados, como Power BI ou Tableau será um diferencial.

• Experiência com plataformas de streaming de dados, como Kafka.

title: Desenvolvedor AEM, Senior
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Desenvolvedor AEM, Senior em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Who Are We.


Newfold Digital is a leading web technology company serving nearly seven million customers globally. Established in 2021 through the combination of leading web services providers Endurance Web Presence and Web.com Group, our portfolio of brands includes: Bluehost, BigRock, ResellerClub, CrazyDomains, HostGator, Network Solutions, Register.com, Web.com and many others.


We help customers of all sizes build a digital presence that delivers results. With our extensive product offerings and personalized support, we take pride in collaborating with our customers to serve their online presence needs.


What you’ll do & how you’ll make your mark.

  • Develop and maintain reusable front-end components in Adobe Experience Manager (AEM).

Who you are & what you’ll need to succeed.

  • Advanced English skills .

  • Experience integrating Front-end code with AEM components, templates, and workflows.
  • Familiarity with AEM Sightly (HTL) and Sling models and AEM ecosystem.
  • Excellent communication skills and ability to collaborate effectively in a team environment.


Why you'll love us

  • We offer a 100% remote position with a monthly home office allowance of R$180.00 and an additional allowance for purchasing items for your office.
  • We provide Meal Vouchers or Food Vouchers worth R$44.55 per working day.
  • Health and dental insurance with no co-payment for employees.

  • Life insurance.
  • Free website hosting.

title: Sr. Software Engineer II - Data Solutions & Measurement
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Sr. Software Engineer II - Data Solutions & Measurement em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Cint is a global software leader in technology-enabled digital insights and research technology. The Cint platform automates the insights-gathering process so that companies can gain access to insights faster with unparalleled scale. Cint has one of the world’s largest consumer networks for digital survey-based research, made up of over 239 million engaged respondents across more than 130 countries. Over 4,600 insights-driven companies use Cint to accelerate how they gather consumer insights and supercharge business growth.

Job Description

The Team

The Cint Technology team is looking for a Senior Software Engineer II to join our international Measurement team. This position is for a software engineer who likes challenges. Our business has been doubling in the last few years, and so our systems need to scale to accommodate this growth.

What You Will Do

Our ideal candidate considers themselves among the highly technical and likes to push the limits of their knowledge and experience every day. In this role, you will work on designing, implementing, scaling, and maintaining the code that powers our production systems. With great freedom to innovate, you will play a key role in world-class research building the next generation of Cint products.

This is a remote opportunity for all over the country!

Qualifications

  • Strong and seasoned hands-on professional backend software development experience

  • Degree in Computer Science or related field

  • Proficient programming skills in Java

  • Comfortable maintaining Python code legacy

  • Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines and testing frameworks

  • Experience with API integration

  • Experience with AWS, Docker, Kubernetes, SQL

title: Executive Assistant
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Executive Assistant em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Executive Assistant to a US CEO — Sales-Driven, Self-Starters Only

Read this whole thing before you apply. It's a filter.

We place Executive Assistants with US home-service business owners. You won't be a task-rabbit. You'll be the CEO's right hand — the person who moves the needle on whatever the business needs that week.


Your #1 job: make sure deals close. Appointment setting, direct sales, follow-up that doesn't quit. From there it widens — hiring providers, dispatching, customer satisfaction, finding new ways to grow the business. We're not hiring an assistant. We're hiring a mini-CEO who makes the big CEO's life bigger.


This role is for people who take the reins. Nobody is going to hand you a checklist every morning. You see the gap, you close the gap. If you need to be told what to do next, stop reading — this will frustrate both of us.


The pay grows when you do:

  • Start at $1,000/mo
  • Hit your first KPI → $1,250/mo
  • Hit the next → $1,400/mo
  • Performance bonuses from the business owner on top — up to $400/mo more

The ceiling moves because you move it. We don't cap people who produce.


What you need to have:

  • Fluent, clear, neutral English — easy for a US homeowner to understand on a call
  • Proven sales or appointment-setting background (show us the receipts)
  • Comfortable owning a number, not just doing tasks
  • Cold calling is a plus, not a must


The non-negotiables — apply only if these are a yes:

  • Available across all US time zones (PST/CST/MST/EST)
  • Up to 50 hours/week. This is firm.
  • Saturday mornings when the business needs it
  • Comfortable with Hubstaff time tracking. We use it for transparency, not to micromanage or punish — that's not how we operate. But it's part of the job.


If you read the hours and the ownership bar and felt more interested, not less — you're who we're looking for. Hit Easy Apply. If you're a fit, we'll come back to you fast — we move quick when we find the right person.

title: Software Application Engineer
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Software Application Engineer em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

***Please send your CV in English


About Foretellix:

Foretellix is the gold standard for data-driven autonomy development toolchains. Foretellix’s Foretify™ toolchain enables a measurable, efficient, and trusted path to safe and scalable autonomy that helps you launch with confidence. Building on its industry leading V&V technology, Foretellix is enabling the AI autonomy revolution.


Role Description:

Be part of the Application Engineering Team responsible for adapting and deploying Foretellix verification & validation solutions to our customers and making them successful at their mission to provide next-gen ADAS/AV products. Our Application Engineers have a unique mix of ADAS/AV domain knowledge, software expertise, creativity, and the ability to work closely with customers to maximize the impact our solution can have on their ability to deliver high quality, safe products.


What will you do:

  • Deploy the Foretellix solution at customer accounts. From tools installation and integration, customer training and ramp-up, to defining the V&V strategy, including both remote and on-site support.
  • Shape our products by being the primary point of contact between the customer and R&D. Understand the customer’s V&V challenges and translate them into product requirements to help improve the products.
  • Work with the sales team as the technical product expert to develop and deliver demos and presentations to customers, as well as guide and support customer product evaluations.
  • When required, create application notes, methodology documents, technical presentations and customer trainings.


Requirements:

  • At least 3 years of industry working experience, ideally in the ADAS/AV domain.
  • Knowledge in Software Engineering, including OO programming, testing, and debugging.
  • BSc or above in the areas of Computer Science, Automotive Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Robotics, or other related fields.
  • Have excellent human relationship skills
  • Be communicative and fluent in English, both verbal and in writing.
  • Be a team-player, resourceful, and professional.


Advantages:

  • Experience in ADAS/AV V&V, testing, and simulation.
  • Previous experience in customer facing engineering such as Field Application Engineering, Sales Engineering, Professional Services, or related positions.
  • Running and working with ADAS/AV Simulators, e.g. Carla, Sumo, Carmaker, Vires, etc...
  • Employee in one of the ADAS/AV companies, or one of the companies serving them.
  • Previous experience as a Product Manager / Methodology Engineer.
  • Knowledge & experience with ADAS/AV verification.
  • Knowledge & experience with advanced verification, and specifically with Specman and the ‘e’ language, and/or SystemVerilog UVM, Perspec PSS, and Coverage Driven Verification.
  • MSc or above in the areas of Computer Science, Automotive Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Robotics, or other related fields.
  • Substantial experience in Software Engineering, including OO programming.

title: Assistente de gestão de projetos
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Assistente de gestão de projetos em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

NÍVEL PLENO - OPERAÇÕES, FLUXOS E ATENDIMENTO


O que esperamos desta profissional na Alter

Buscamos uma profissional que enxergue a operação como um sistema vivo.

Mais do que controlar tarefas, queremos alguém capaz de entender a lógica dos projetos, antecipar conflitos de agenda, equilibrar a carga de trabalho da equipe e garantir que cada cliente tenha uma experiência organizada, transparente e eficiente.

Ela será uma das principais guardiãs dos processos da Alter, ajudando a transformar planejamento em execução e execução em resultados.


Compromisso com Diversidade e Inclusão

Esta vaga é destinada prioritariamente a mulheres negras, como parte da estratégia da Alter de ampliar a presença de profissionais negras em funções técnicas, de coordenação e liderança.

A Alter acredita que equipes diversas produzem melhores soluções, ampliam perspectivas e fortalecem a capacidade de inovação e transformação da comunicação.


Objetivo da posição

Garantir a organização, fluidez e eficiência da operação da Alter, atuando como elo entre clientes, equipe e lideranças. A profissional será responsável por coordenar cronogramas, distribuir demandas, acompanhar entregas, monitorar prazos e apoiar o atendimento aos clientes, assegurando qualidade, produtividade e alinhamento entre todas as áreas envolvidas.

Na prática, esta posição funciona como uma combinação entre gestão de projetos, tráfego interno, coordenação operacional e atendimento , sendo peça-chave para a sustentação da rotina da agência.


Principais responsabilidades

Gestão de Projetos e Operações

  • Elaborar, atualizar e monitorar cronogramas de projetos.
  • Estruturar planos de trabalho e fluxos de execução.
  • Garantir o cumprimento de prazos e entregas.
  • Identificar gargalos, riscos e desvios de cronograma.
  • Apoiar lideranças na priorização de demandas.
  • Coordenar múltiplos projetos simultaneamente.

Tráfego Interno

  • Distribuir atividades entre as equipes de conteúdo, imprensa, design, audiovisual e marketing.
  • Controlar capacidade produtiva e ocupação da equipe.
  • Acompanhar status de execução das tarefas.
  • Cobrar atualizações e garantir visibilidade sobre o andamento dos projetos.
  • Apoiar o planejamento de férias, ausências e remanejamento de recursos.

Atendimento e Relacionamento com Clientes

  • Participar de reuniões de alinhamento.
  • Registrar e organizar demandas dos clientes.
  • Produzir atas, encaminhamentos e planos de ação.
  • Realizar acompanhamento cotidiano dos projetos.
  • Garantir que expectativas, escopo e cronogramas estejam alinhados entre cliente e equipe.

Processos e Melhoria Contínua

  • Apoiar a implementação e evolução de processos internos.
  • Alimentar ferramentas de gestão.
  • Produzir relatórios de acompanhamento.
  • Sugerir melhorias operacionais.
  • Contribuir para a padronização de fluxos, documentos e rotinas.


Requisitos obrigatórios

  • Formação em Comunicação, Administração, Marketing, Relações Públicas, Gestão de Projetos ou áreas correlatas.
  • Experiência prévia em agências de comunicação, marketing ou consultorias.
  • Vivência em gestão de projetos e atendimento.
  • Excelente organização e capacidade de planejamento.
  • Domínio de ferramentas de gestão de projetos.

Conhecimento obrigatório em:

  • Trello
  • ClickUp
  • Google Workspace
  • Excel ou Google Sheets


Diferenciais

  • Certificação em metodologias ágeis.
  • Conhecimento em gestão de capacidade produtiva (HH).
  • Experiência em projetos de comunicação corporativa.
  • Vivência com clientes de sustentabilidade, terceiro setor ou organismos internacionais.
  • Conhecimento básico de CRM.
  • Familiaridade com Inteligência Artificial aplicada à produtividade e gestão, ESPECIALMENTE CLAUDE.


Competências comportamentais

Organização extrema

Consegue administrar simultaneamente dezenas de entregas, projetos e interlocutores sem perder controle de prioridades.

Capacidade de coordenação

Tem habilidade para mobilizar pessoas, cobrar retornos e manter os projetos em movimento sem gerar ruídos desnecessários.

Comunicação clara

Consegue traduzir demandas, alinhar expectativas e facilitar a comunicação entre diferentes áreas.

Senso de urgência

Entende a diferença entre o que é importante, urgente e estratégico.

Proatividade

Antecipar problemas é mais importante do que reagir a eles.

Inteligência relacional

Lida bem com clientes, equipes multidisciplinares e diferentes estilos de trabalho.


Indicadores de desempenho

  • Percentual de entregas realizadas dentro do prazo.
  • Taxa de retrabalho.
  • Cumprimento dos cronogramas dos projetos.
  • Satisfação dos clientes.
  • Nível de ocupação e distribuição equilibrada da equipe.
  • Tempo médio de resposta às demandas.
  • Qualidade dos registros, atas e controles operacionais.
  • Redução de gargalos e atrasos recorrentes.

title: Software Application Engineer
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Software Application Engineer em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

***Please send your CV in English


About Foretellix:

Foretellix is the gold standard for data-driven autonomy development toolchains. Foretellix’s Foretify™ toolchain enables a measurable, efficient, and trusted path to safe and scalable autonomy that helps you launch with confidence. Building on its industry leading V&V technology, Foretellix is enabling the AI autonomy revolution.


Role Description:

Be part of the Application Engineering Team responsible for adapting and deploying Foretellix verification & validation solutions to our customers and making them successful at their mission to provide next-gen ADAS/AV products. Our Application Engineers have a unique mix of ADAS/AV domain knowledge, software expertise, creativity, and the ability to work closely with customers to maximize the impact our solution can have on their ability to deliver high quality, safe products.


What will you do:

  • Deploy the Foretellix solution at customer accounts. From tools installation and integration, customer training and ramp-up, to defining the V&V strategy, including both remote and on-site support.
  • Shape our products by being the primary point of contact between the customer and R&D. Understand the customer’s V&V challenges and translate them into product requirements to help improve the products.
  • Work with the sales team as the technical product expert to develop and deliver demos and presentations to customers, as well as guide and support customer product evaluations.
  • When required, create application notes, methodology documents, technical presentations and customer trainings.


Requirements:

  • At least 3 years of industry working experience, ideally in the ADAS/AV domain.
  • Knowledge in Software Engineering, including OO programming, testing, and debugging.
  • BSc or above in the areas of Computer Science, Automotive Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Robotics, or other related fields.
  • Have excellent human relationship skills
  • Be communicative and fluent in English, both verbal and in writing.
  • Be a team-player, resourceful, and professional.


Advantages:

  • Experience in ADAS/AV V&V, testing, and simulation.
  • Previous experience in customer facing engineering such as Field Application Engineering, Sales Engineering, Professional Services, or related positions.
  • Running and working with ADAS/AV Simulators, e.g. Carla, Sumo, Carmaker, Vires, etc...
  • Employee in one of the ADAS/AV companies, or one of the companies serving them.
  • Previous experience as a Product Manager / Methodology Engineer.
  • Knowledge & experience with ADAS/AV verification.
  • Knowledge & experience with advanced verification, and specifically with Specman and the ‘e’ language, and/or SystemVerilog UVM, Perspec PSS, and Coverage Driven Verification.
  • MSc or above in the areas of Computer Science, Automotive Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Robotics, or other related fields.
  • Substantial experience in Software Engineering, including OO programming.

title: Desenvolvedor MuleSoft Sênior
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Desenvolvedor MuleSoft Sênior em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Olá!


Somos a @Runtalent, com DNA inovador, consolidados no mercado de tecnologia e especializados em soluções de TI há quase duas décadas. Acompanhamos todos os avanços tecnológicos dos últimos anos e estamos juntos nessa corrida pela transformação digital.

Temos uma oportunidade para:


Desenvolvedor MuleSoft Sênior


Modelo de atuação: remoto

Tempo de Projeto: Indeterminado


Requisitos

  • Experiência sólida com desenvolvimento utilizando a plataforma MuleSoft Anypoint Platform ;
  • Experiência em design, desenvolvimento e implementação de soluções MuleSoft em ambientes On-Premises e CloudHub ;
  • Proficiência no desenho e desenvolvimento de APIs e fluxos de integração;
  • Experiência com integrações de sistemas backend;
  • Conhecimento em ferramentas de controle de versão (Git, SVN, etc.) e gerenciamento de projetos;
  • Capacidade de atuar de forma colaborativa em equipes multidisciplinares e excelente comunicação interpessoal;
  • Forte habilidade analítica, resolução de problemas e atenção aos detalhes;
  • Conhecimento em API Lifecycle Management ;
  • Experiência em análise e otimização de desempenho de aplicações;
  • Vivência em desenvolvimento e integração de software e/ou plataformas ESB;
  • Conhecimentos em bancos de dados relacionais e não relacionais, como MySQL, SQL Server, Oracle e MongoDB ;
  • Desejável experiência com arquiteturas orientadas a serviços (SOA ) e orientadas a eventos (EDA );
  • Desejável certificação MuleSoft Certified Developer .

Competências Comportamentais

  • Dinamismo;
  • Proatividade;
  • Pensamento analítico;
  • Raciocínio lógico;
  • Inovação;
  • Facilidade para aprendizado contínuo;
  • Interesse por novas tendências e tecnologias de desenvolvimento.

Principais Responsabilidades

  • Projetar, desenvolver e gerenciar APIs e fluxos de integração utilizando a plataforma MuleSoft Anypoint Platform ;
  • Colaborar com equipes técnicas na construção de soluções de integração escaláveis, eficientes e alinhadas às necessidades do negócio;
  • Desenvolver soluções seguindo requisitos funcionais e técnicos, garantindo aderência às melhores práticas de desenvolvimento;
  • Projetar arquiteturas de comunicação entre sistemas, priorizando reutilização, simplicidade e governança;
  • Levantar, analisar e interpretar requisitos para desenvolvimento de integrações e serviços MuleSoft;
  • Projetar APIs RESTful utilizando RAML , Anypoint Platform e API Manager ;
  • Criar, estruturar e manter APIs corporativas e soluções de integração;
  • Desenvolver e implementar interfaces para integração com serviços SOAP , REST e bancos de dados internos e externos;
  • Desenvolver, construir, implantar, monitorar e testar aplicações e APIs MuleSoft, incluindo:
  • Experience APIs;
  • Process APIs;
  • System APIs.

Diferenciais

  • Certificações MuleSoft e/ou certificações relacionadas a integração e APIs;
  • Experiência em ambientes corporativos de alta complexidade;
  • Conhecimento em práticas DevOps e CI/CD aplicadas a integrações.

Service Engineer - Full stack - Agular & .NET - Job Summary

We are seeking a highly experienced Senior Full Stack Developer with deep expertise in Angular and .NET to join our engineering team. In this role, you will be responsible for designing, developing, and delivering scalable, secure, and high-performance web applications across the full technology stack. You will play a key role in system architecture, lead technical initiatives, and collaborate closely with cross-functional teams to build modern, enterprise-grade solutions. This is an excellent opportunity for a senior engineer who is passionate about clean code, modern frameworks, and delivering impactful digital products.

Key Responsibilities

Design, develop, and maintain full stack applications using Angular (frontend) and .NET (backend)

Lead system architecture and contribute to design decisions for scalable and maintainable systems

Develop responsive, user-friendly UI components and integrate them with backend services

Build and maintain RESTful APIs and microservices using .NET technologies

Collaborate with product managers, designers, QA engineers, and other stakeholders

Optimize application performance, security, and scalability

Perform code reviews and ensure adherence to best practices and coding standards

Mentor and guide junior and mid-level developers

Participate in Agile/Scrum processes and contribute to continuous improvement

10+ years of professional software development experience

Strong expertise in Angular (preferably Angular 10+) and TypeScript

Solid understanding of web architecture, RESTful services, and API design

Experience with Azure (App Services, Functions, DevOps, etc.) or other cloud platforms (AWS, GCP)

Experience with logging and monitoring tools (Application Insights, ELK stack, Prometheus)

Exposure to domain-driven design (DDD) and clean architecture principles

+G86

Strong analytical and problem-solving skills

Excellent communication and collaboration abilities across technical and non-technical teams

Proven leadership and mentoring experience

High level of ownership, accountability, and initiative

Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment

Strong attention to detail and commitment to high-quality deliverables

Adaptability and eagerness to learn and adopt new technologies

Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field

Master’s degree is a plus but not required

title: Business Specialist
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Business Specialist em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.


1, Document Preparation and Analysis (Pre-Shipment): This phase focuses on ensuring all documentation is correct before shipment. It includes receiving and checking the Purchase Order (PO), the fiscal classification (NCM) of the goods, analyzing draft documents (CI, PL, BL drafts), and initial registration in the system.



2, Shipment Management and Customs Procedures: This stage covers the active management of the process while the cargo is in transit. It involves obtaining the Import License (LI), collecting original documents, validating the Bill of Lading (BL), and continuous coordination with the customs broker and the bonded terminal


.
3, Clearance Monitoring and Closing (Post-Arrival): This phase begins upon cargo arrival. It includes full door-to-door logistics follow-up, cargo presence confirmation, monitoring customs clearance (DI/DUIMP), coordinating domestic transport, and finally, archiving all documents to close the proces


s.
4, Invoice Auditing and Cost Validation: This phase focuses on verifying the accuracy of all operational costs before payment. It includes receiving and cross-referencing invoices (from freight forwarders, carriers, terminals, customs brokers) against negotiated tariffs, operational records, and system data (e.g., demurrage/detention days, storage fees) to identify and dispute discrepanci


es.
5, Payment Processing and Budget Allocation: This stage covers the financial execution and control. It involves launching approved invoices into the financial system (ERP), correctly allocating all costs to the specific import process or cost center, scheduling payments according to financial policy, and serving as the main point of contact for supplier payment inquir


ies.
6, Cost Analysis and Performance Reporting: This final phase focuses on data analysis and strategic support. It includes compiling financial data, generating periodic reports (e.g., total logistics cost, cost-per-container, variance analysis against budget), and providing data-driven insights to support new supplier negotiations and identify cost-saving opportuni

ties.

1, Document Preparation and Analysis (Pre-Shipment): This phase focuses on ensuring all documentation is correct before shipment. It includes receiving and checking the Purchase Order (PO), the fiscal classification (NCM) of the goods, analyzing draft documents (CI, PL, BL drafts), and initial registration in the system.



2, Shipment Management and Customs Procedures: This stage covers the active management of the process while the cargo is in transit. It involves obtaining the Import License (LI), collecting original documents, validating the Bill of Lading (BL), and continuous coordination with the customs broker and the bonded terminal


.
3, Clearance Monitoring and Closing (Post-Arrival): This phase begins upon cargo arrival. It includes full door-to-door logistics follow-up, cargo presence confirmation, monitoring customs clearance (DI/DUIMP), coordinating domestic transport, and finally, archiving all documents to close the proces


s.
4, Invoice Auditing and Cost Validation: This phase focuses on verifying the accuracy of all operational costs before payment. It includes receiving and cross-referencing invoices (from freight forwarders, carriers, terminals, customs brokers) against negotiated tariffs, operational records, and system data (e.g., demurrage/detention days, storage fees) to identify and dispute discrepanci


es.
5, Payment Processing and Budget Allocation: This stage covers the financial execution and control. It involves launching approved invoices into the financial system (ERP), correctly allocating all costs to the specific import process or cost center, scheduling payments according to financial policy, and serving as the main point of contact for supplier payment inquir


ies.
6, Cost Analysis and Performance Reporting: This final phase focuses on data analysis and strategic support. It includes compiling financial data, generating periodic reports (e.g., total logistics cost, cost-per-container, variance analysis against budget), and providing data-driven insights to support new supplier negotiations and identify cost-saving opportuni

ties.

title: Software Engineer- AI Integration
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Software Engineer- AI Integration em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Position : Software Engineer (AI Integration)

Location: Remote/Work From Home in Brazil

Employment Type : CLT

Monthly Salary Range: 10-22k Reais/month



Requirements:

-Working knowledge of Java (21+) and Spring Boot (REST APIs, Spring Data JPA, Spring Security)


-Experience with Oracle Database: SQL, joins, indexing, stored procedures, and JPA/Hibernate mapping


-Strong understanding of RESTful API design and documentation (OpenAPI/Swagger)


-Solid Python proficiency (async/await, type hints, virtual environments, packaging)


-Hands-on experience with at least one LLM orchestration framework (LangChain, LangGraph, LlamaIndex, or equivalent)


-Experience consuming LLM APIs and applying prompt engineering best practices


-Exposure to agentic AI concepts: tool-calling, function calling, ReAct patterns, RAG, vector stores


-Familiari ty with FastAPI or similar frameworks for serving AI pipelines



Nice to have skills and experience:


-Experience with LangGraph specifically (stateful multi-agent graphs, conditional routing, checkpointing)


-Exposure to enterprise integrations: ServiceNow, LDAP/AD, Microsoft Graph API, JIRA, or similar


-Familiarity with observability tools: logging, tracing (LangSmith, OpenTelemetry), and metrics


-Exp erience with prompt testing frameworks or evals for LLM quality assurance


About the Role


We're looking for a Full Stack Engineer with a strong foundation across front-end, back-end, and AI/ML technologies to join a forward-thinking engineering team. In this role, you'll build and maintain web applications powered by modern frameworks while integrating cutting-edge AI capabilities — including Large Language Models (LLMs) and agentic AI patterns — into real-world business workflows. If you enjoy working across the entire stack and are excited about bringing AI from prototype to production, this is the role for you



What You'll Do

  • Build & maintain fron t-end interfaces using Angular (or equivalent component-based frameworks), delivering clean and responsive user experiences.


  • Develop back-end services in Java 21+ and Spring Boot, including REST APIs, data persistence with Spring Data JPA, and foundational security with Spring Security


  • Design and manage database interactions with Oracle Database — writing optimized SQL, managing joins, indexing, stored procedures, and JPA/Hibernate entity mappings.


  • Architect and document RESTful APIs following best practices, with clear documentation via OpenAPI/Swagger.


  • Build and deploy AI/ML pipelines in Python, leveraging LLM orchestration frameworks (LangChain, LangGraph, LlamaIndex, or similar) and serving them through FastAPI or equivalent frameworks.


  • Integrate LLM APIs (OpenAI, Azure OpenAI, Anthropic, Cohere, etc.) into applications using prompt engineering best practices.


  • Implement agentic AI patterns including tool-calling, function calling, ReAct workflows, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), and vector store integrations.


  • Translate ambiguous b usiness problems into clear technical requirements by interpreting SOPs, process documents, and workflow diagrams.


  • Collaborate cross-functionally in an Agile team environment, communicating technical concepts clearly to non-technical stakeholders

title: AI Engineer
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para AI Engineer em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

We are seeking a versatile and highly skilled AI Engineer to join our fast-growing Full-Stack AI Solutions company. This role blends the expertise of building cutting-edge AI/ML models with the practical know-how of automation and agentic system integrations. You will design, develop, deploy, and optimize intelligent solutions that leverage the power of generative AI, automation platforms, and agent-based systems to enhance client operations, streamline workflows, and deliver measurable results.

This is a unique opportunity to work across a diverse range of technologies—from fine-tuning transformer models to building real-world AI-powered automation stacks. If you’re passionate about pushing the boundaries of AI while creating real value through systems thinking and practical implementation, this role is for you.


Key Responsibilities

AI/ML Development:

  • Design, build, and deploy machine learning and generative AI models for custom use cases.
  • Fine-tune and optimize large language models (e.g., GPT, BERT) using frameworks like Hugging Face Transformers.
  • Conduct ongoing research to stay ahead of advancements in AI/ML, including LLMs, generative AI, and transformer-based architectures.
  • Develop data pipelines for preprocessing, feature engineering, and model training.
  • Test, validate, and monitor model performance in real-world scenarios; iterate for reliability and accuracy.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to embed AI into products, platforms, and services.
  • Mentor junior engineers and contribute to technical leadership.

Automation & Agentic Systems:

  • Design, implement, and maintain automation workflows using tools such as:
  • LangChain, LangGraph, LangSmith, LangFuse n8n, ElevenLabs, and CMS integrations.
  • Engineer system-to-system integrations using APIs to enable intelligent process automation.
  • Apply prompt and context engineering techniques to enhance the performance of conversational AI tools.
  • Implement prompt management and QA processes for agents and assistants.
  • Explore and deploy Microsoft Copilot Studio, PowerApps, and PowerAutomate solutions (preferred but not required).
  • Continuously evaluate emerging AI and automation tools and assess their applicability in client use cases.
  • Collaborate with clients and internal teams to scope, deliver, and maintain agentic and automation solutions aligned with business goals.


Qualifications

Required

  • 2+ years of hands-on experience in AI/ML development, including training and deploying models in production.
  • Strong programming skills in Python, with proficiency in frameworks such as TensorFlow, PyTorch, Scikit-learn, and Hugging Face Transformers.
  • Experience working with AI tools like Langchain, OpenAI, or Stable Diffusion.
  • Practical experience with automation platforms and AI agent builders (as listed above).
  • Deep understanding of machine learning algorithms, neural networks, and NLP concepts.
  • Proficiency in using REST APIs for tool and platform integrations.
  • Familiarity with cloud-based AI/ML platforms.
  • Strong analytical skills and the ability to translate business problems into technical AI/automation solutions.

Preferred

  • Experience working with Agentic AI frameworks, voice automation, and prompt tuning systems.
  • Exposure to MLOps best practices, including model versioning, CI/CD, and monitoring.
  • Knowledge of reinforcement learning, GANs, or edge AI deployments.
  • Familiarity with distributed computing frameworks such as Spark or Ray.
  • Background in AI agency workflows and client-facing solution delivery.


Work Environment & Benefits


  • Competitive salary and performance-based incentives.
  • Flexible work environment: Remote-first.
  • Collaborative, innovation-driven culture with a commitment to personal and professional growth.
  • Opportunity to work at the forefront of AI innovation across industries and verticals.

title: Customer Success Manager
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Customer Success Manager em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

WHO ARE WE?


We are a bunch of super enthusiastic, passionate, and highly driven people, working to achieve a common goal! We believe that work and the workplace should be joyful and always buzzing with energy!


CloudSEK, one of India’s most trusted Cyber security product companies, is on a mission to build the world’s fastest and most reliable AI technology that identifies and resolves digital threats in real-time. The central proposition is leveraging Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning to create a quick and reliable analysis and alert system that provides rapid detection across multiple internet sources, precise threat analysis, and prompt resolution with minimal human intervention.


Founded in 2015, headquartered at Singapore, we are proud to say that we’ve grown at a frenetic pace and have been able to achieve some accolades along the way, including:


CloudSEK’s Product Suite:


CloudSEK XVigil constantly maps a customer’s digital assets, identifies threats and enriches them with cyber intelligence, and then provides workflows to manage and remediate all identified threats including takedown support.

A powerful Attack Surface Monitoring tool that gives visibility and intelligence on customers’ attack surfaces. CloudSEK's BeVigil uses a combination of Mobile, Web, Network and Encryption Scanners to map and protect known and unknown assets.

CloudSEK’s Contextual AI SVigil identifies software supply chain risks by monitoring Software, Cloud Services, and third-party dependencies.

Key Milestones:


  • 2016: Launched our first product.
  • 2018: Secured Pre-series A funding.
  • 2019: Expanded operations to India, Southeast Asia, and the Americas.
  • 2020: Won the NASSCOM-DSCI Excellence Award for Security Product Company of the Year.
  • 2021: Raised $7M in Series A funding led by MassMutual Ventures.
  • Awards & Recognition: Won NetApp Excellerator's \"Best Growth Strategy Award,\" CloudSEK XVigil joined NVIDIA Inception Program, and won the NASSCOM Emerge 50 Cybersecurity Award.
  • 2025: Secured $19 million in funding led by Tenacity Ventures, Commvault.


Job Description:

As a Customer Success Manager at CloudSEK , you will be the primary point of contact for a few strategic accounts, ensuring they derive maximum value from our cybersecurity solutions . Your role will involve deep engagement with clients , providing expert guidance on threat management, and ensuring seamless integration and utilization of CloudSEK’s products . Your background in cybersecurity will be crucial in understanding and addressing the specific needs and challenges faced by our clients.


Key Responsibilities:


Account Management:

  • Manage and nurture relationships for a client accounts, ensuring high levels of customer satisfaction and retention.
  • Conduct Quarterly Business Reviews (QBRs) and Annual Business Reviews (ABRs) to assess and enhance customer engagement.
  • Visit customers twice a year to strengthen relationships and understand their evolving needs.

Cybersecurity Expertise:

  • Provide expert guidance on threat intelligence, data leak prevention, and other cybersecurity issues.
  • Act as a security analyst, offering insights and recommendations based on threats generated by CloudSEK’s platform.
  • Collaborate with customer security teams to ensure optimal usage of CloudSEK’s solutions.

Customer Engagement:

  • Develop and execute customer engagement strategies to build strong relationships with key stakeholders, including CXOs and CISOs.
  • Foster customer champions within client organizations to drive advocacy and referrals.
  • Generate and share client-specific quality reports, gathering feedback to continuously improve service delivery.

Revenue Generation and Retention:

  • Identify opportunities for upselling and cross-selling CloudSEK’s products and services.
  • Ensure on-time renewals and maintain a high customer retention rate.
  • Source referrals and participate in revenue generation activities.

Product Usage and Feedback:

  • Ensure 100% product usage for features subscribed by the customers.
  • Conduct configuration reviews and provide recommendations for product enhancements.
  • Gather and analyze customer feedback to contribute to product development and improvement.

Operational Excellence:

  • Maintain accurate records of customer interactions and activities in CRM systems.
  • Contribute to the team by sharing knowledge, conducting training sessions, and writing internal articles.


Ideal candidate:

  • 4-5 years of experience in Cybersecurity & Client-facing experience, or a related role in the cybersecurity industry.
  • Strong understanding of cybersecurity principles, threat intelligence, and digital risk management.
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to build strong relationships with clients. Strong language proficiency over English and Portuguese is required.
  • Proven track record of achieving customer success goals and driving revenue growth.
  • Ability to work independently and manage multiple accounts simultaneously.


Cookie points if you have experience in the below skills:

  • Business reviews:
  • Onsite meetings
  • Maintaining NRR and GRR
  • Threat analysis and Value delivery


Benefits of Joining CloudSEK:

We provide an environment where you can develop and enhance your skills while delivering meaningful work that matters. You’ll be rewarded a competitive salary as well as a full spectrum of generous perks and incentives which include:

  • Infraestrutura e Deploy: Trabalhar com Docker para manter ambientes consistentes e atuar ativamente em esteiras de CI/CD para entregas contínuas.



Formação e Experiência


  • Experiência Específica em RH: Experiência comprovada na construção de sistemas de Recursos Humanos (HCM/HRMS), Departamento Pessoal, Workforce Management (ponto/escalas) ou plataformas de processamento financeiro complexo.
  • Experiência Técnica: Sólida vivência em desenvolvimento full stack corporativo, atuando de ponta a ponta na concepção de produtos.
  • Metodologias: Sólida vivência com metodologias ágeis (Scrum, Kanban) em times de produto, além de entendimento claro de workflows como GitFlow.
  • Formação: Ensino Superior em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia de Software, Sistemas de Informação ou experiência prática equivalente.



Habilidades Técnicas (Hard Skills)


  • Stack Principal: Domínio avançado do ecossistema Node.js (NestJS, Express) e React (incluindo Next.js). Familiaridade com TypeScript e Vue.js.
  • Bancos de Dados: Proficiência em bancos relacionais (PostgreSQL, MySQL), ORMs, modelagem de tabelas e entendimento profundo de DER, além de transações consistentes.
  • DevOps & Cloud: Excelente conhecimento em Docker e ambiente Linux. Vivência prática com provedores Cloud (GCP, Azure) e cultura DevOps (CI/CD).
  • Ferramentas: Proficiência com Git/GitHub e experiência no uso de ferramentas de IA assistiva (como Claude Code ou similares).



Habilidades Comportamentais (Soft Skills)


  • Autonomia e Pragmatismo: Capacidade de resolver problemas complexos com autonomia, propondo melhorias técnicas e transitando entre tecnologias de forma pragmática, focando na melhor solução para o contexto.
  • Foco no Usuário e Qualidade: Entender a criticidade financeira e humana de um sistema de DP/RH, responsabilizando-se pelo funcionamento impecável das regras de negócio.
  • Tradução de Requisitos: Facilidade para dialogar com especialistas de DP/RH para transformar leis e portarias em lógica matemática de software.
  • Gestão de Crise: Perfil analítico para lidar com gargalos ou bugs de forma ágil e fria, especialmente em momentos críticos (fechamento de folha).



Diferenciais


  • Experiência com React Native para desenvolvimento mobile.
  • Conhecimentos avançados em performance de aplicações e otimização de queries de banco de dados.
  • Conhecimento prévio em PHP e/ou Python para auxiliar na manutenção ou migração de sistemas legados.
  • Ter atuado em HRTechs ou possuir forte interesse no desenvolvimento de produtos para a área da saúde.

100% Remoto

You will then use your analytical skills to assess the quality of the model's personalised responses, evaluating dimensions such as grounding, integration, and helpfulness.


Offer Details:

  • Duration of Contract : 12 months
  • Pay: $1500 per month (net/take-home)
  • Mode of work: Fully Remote
  • Number of Positions: 20
  • Must have fluency in Portugal Portuguese (not Brazilian Portuguese)



Key Qualifications:

  • Portuguese Proficiency : Ability to read and write in Portugal Portuguese (not Brazilian Portuguese) with a high degree of comp, as Portuguese is the focus language for this project.
  • Personal Account Usage: Willing to use computer science, primary personal Google account (not a testing account), and enable personal data sources for a genuine assessment.
  • Schedule Flexibility: Full-time availability in your local time zone is required. We are staffing a global, 24-hour operations team.
  • Exceptional Analytical Thinking: Demonstrate the ability to evaluate nuanced and ambiguous AI responses, specifically assessing personalisation quality.
  • Creative Prompt Engineering: Experience in designing creative, multi-turn starting prompts based on personal context to thoroughly test the model's capabilities.
  • Strong Evaluation Acumen: Understanding of personalisation concepts, including the ability to identify incorrect personalisation, poor inferences, and forced connections.
  • Meticulous Attention to Detail: The ability to review Side-by-Side (SxS) model responses and spot subtle differences in naturalness and over-narrating.
  • Excellent Written Communication: Superior ability to write clear, concise, and structured rationales for model rankings, explicitly referencing specific turn numbers.
  • Feedback: Ability to provide constructive feedback and detailed annotations.
  • Communication: Excellent communication and collaboration skills.
  • Independence: Self-motivated and able to work independently in a remote setting.
  • Technical Setup: Desktop/laptop set up with a good internet connection.


Description:

  • In this role, you will be part of a dynamic team focused on evaluating the quality of personalised AI interactions. Your day-to-day work will involve:
  • Designing and executing multi-turn conversational prompts (typically 1-5 turns) that require the AI to utilise your personal information and experiences.
  • Evaluating model responses based on your intent from the starting prompt, checking if the personalisation was appropriately applied.
  • Analysing responses for grounding issues, ensuring claims about you are supported by evidence and not flawed inferences or hallucinations.
  • Assessing integration quality to ensure personal data is woven naturally into the response without robotic \"over-narrating\".
  • Rigorously evaluating and stack-ranking two model responses side-by-side (SxS) to determine which is overall more helpful, easy to use, and enjoyable.
  • Writing clear, defensible rationales for your comparisons, explicitly referencing where issues or positive aspects occurred in the conversation.
  • Extracting and verifying \"Debug Info\" from the model to confirm that chat summaries and data sources were properly utilised.
  • Maintaining strict data hygiene by deleting evaluation conversations to prevent them from polluting your future chat history.



Education & Experience:

  • BS/BA degree or equivalent experience in a relevant field (e.g., policy, law, ethics, linguistics, journalism, computer science, or a related analytical field).
  • Experience in data annotation, AI quality evaluation, content moderation, or a related role is strongly preferred.


Additional Details:

  • Commitments Required: at least 4 hours per day and up to 40 hours per week, with 4 hours of overlap with PST.
  • Engagement type: Contractor
  • Engagement Length: 12 months

title: AI Quality Analyst (Portgugal Portuguese )
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para AI Quality Analyst (Portgugal Portuguese ) em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Company Description:

MillionLogics is a trusted Oracle Partner and global leader in IT solutions, with operations in London, UK, and a development hub in Hyderabad, India. Specialising in innovative and scalable services, MillionLogics empowers enterprises through data & AI, cloud solutions, IT consulting, and custom application development. With a team of 85+ AI/ML experts, we deliver tailored solutions that foster digital transformation and operational excellence. We are committed to client success. We blend world-class technical expertise with strategic insight to deliver results.


Role Overview:

As an AI quality analyst, you will evaluate a new personalisation feature for Gemini. You will assess how well the model uses information from your past Gemini conversations, Gmail, Google Search, and YouTube activity to make responses more relevant and helpful. This role requires a unique blend of creativity and analytical rigour. You will actively design prompts from your personal experiences. You will then use your analytical skills to assess the quality of the model's personalised responses, evaluating dimensions such as grounding, integration, and helpfulness.


Offer Details:

  • Duration of Contract : 12 months
  • Pay: $1500 per month (net/take-home)
  • Mode of work: Fully Remote
  • Number of Positions: 20
  • Must have fluency in Portugal Portuguese (not Brazilian Portuguese)



Key Qualifications:

  • Portuguese Proficiency : Ability to read and write in Portugal Portuguese (not Brazilian Portuguese) with a high degree of comp, as Portuguese is the focus language for this project.
  • Personal Account Usage: Willing to use computer science, primary personal Google account (not a testing account), and enable personal data sources for a genuine assessment.
  • Schedule Flexibility: Full-time availability in your local time zone is required. We are staffing a global, 24-hour operations team.
  • Exceptional Analytical Thinking: Demonstrate the ability to evaluate nuanced and ambiguous AI responses, specifically assessing personalisation quality.
  • Creative Prompt Engineering: Experience in designing creative, multi-turn starting prompts based on personal context to thoroughly test the model's capabilities.
  • Strong Evaluation Acumen: Understanding of personalisation concepts, including the ability to identify incorrect personalisation, poor inferences, and forced connections.
  • Meticulous Attention to Detail: The ability to review Side-by-Side (SxS) model responses and spot subtle differences in naturalness and over-narrating.
  • Excellent Written Communication: Superior ability to write clear, concise, and structured rationales for model rankings, explicitly referencing specific turn numbers.
  • Feedback: Ability to provide constructive feedback and detailed annotations.
  • Communication: Excellent communication and collaboration skills.
  • Independence: Self-motivated and able to work independently in a remote setting.
  • Technical Setup: Desktop/laptop set up with a good internet connection.


Description:

  • In this role, you will be part of a dynamic team focused on evaluating the quality of personalised AI interactions. Your day-to-day work will involve:
  • Designing and executing multi-turn conversational prompts (typically 1-5 turns) that require the AI to utilise your personal information and experiences.
  • Evaluating model responses based on your intent from the starting prompt, checking if the personalisation was appropriately applied.
  • Analysing responses for grounding issues, ensuring claims about you are supported by evidence and not flawed inferences or hallucinations.
  • Assessing integration quality to ensure personal data is woven naturally into the response without robotic \"over-narrating\".
  • Rigorously evaluating and stack-ranking two model responses side-by-side (SxS) to determine which is overall more helpful, easy to use, and enjoyable.
  • Writing clear, defensible rationales for your comparisons, explicitly referencing where issues or positive aspects occurred in the conversation.
  • Extracting and verifying \"Debug Info\" from the model to confirm that chat summaries and data sources were properly utilised.
  • Maintaining strict data hygiene by deleting evaluation conversations to prevent them from polluting your future chat history.



Education & Experience:

  • BS/BA degree or equivalent experience in a relevant field (e.g., policy, law, ethics, linguistics, journalism, computer science, or a related analytical field).
  • Experience in data annotation, AI quality evaluation, content moderation, or a related role is strongly preferred.


Additional Details:

  • Commitments Required: at least 4 hours per day and up to 40 hours per week, with 4 hours of overlap with PST.
  • Engagement type: Contractor
  • Engagement Length: 12 months
